items.title: Il festival MULTI a Roma: dibattiti su guerre, confini e spazi urbani
items.subtitle: Temi e incontri della quarta edizione del festival MULTI a Piazza Vittorio
items.original_title: A Roma torna MULTI, il festival per unire culture e cucine diverse
items.summary: Dal 24 al 27 settembre i Giardini di Piazza Vittorio a Roma ospitano la quarta edizione del festival MULTI, organizzato da Lucy e Slow Food Roma. Il programma prevede oltre ottanta appuntamenti e cinquanta piatti comunitari, focalizzandosi su narrazione dei conflitti, diritto all'abitare, movimenti di massa e dinamiche relazionali.
bullets: Il festival si svolge dal 24 al 27 settembre a Piazza Vittorio, coinvolgendo comunità internazionali e integrando dibattiti culturali con cucine dal mondo.
L'incontro inaugurale sui conflitti analizza come il flusso mediatico della guerra possa generare assuefazione anziché comprensione, con Paolo Giordano, Annalisa Camilli e Cecilia Sala.
Un focus specifico è dedicato alla vicenda giudiziaria di Alaa Faraj, scagionato dopo dieci anni di carcere e autore del libro Perché ero ragazzo con Alessandra Sciurba.
Il diritto all'abitare viene discusso a partire dall'esperienza di Spin Time, analizzando la gestione dello spazio urbano e la proprietà collettiva.
La rassegna affronta anche la trasformazione dei movimenti di massa e le restrizioni legislative sul dissenso a venticinque anni dal G8 di Genova.

items.title: Google usa l'AI per prevedere e ridurre le scie di condensazione degli aerei
items.subtitle: Come Google usa l'AI per evitare le scie di condensazione persistenti e ridurre il riscaldamento globale.
items.original_title: Google usa l’AI per prevedere dove si formano le scie degli aerei per ridurne l’impatto climatico
items.summary: Google ha sviluppato un modello di intelligenza artificiale per prevedere dove si formeranno scie di condensazione persistenti, consentendo ai piloti di modificare leggermente la quota di volo per mitigarne l'impatto climatico. Test recenti condotti con Cathay Pacific e American Airlines mostrano una riduzione significativa della formazione di scie, pur bilanciando i potenziali aumenti nel consumo di carburante.
bullets: La tecnologia combina dati meteorologici, satellitari e di volo con modelli di intelligenza artificiale per mappare le aree atmosferiche a rischio.
Le indicazioni vengono inviate direttamente in cabina di pilotaggio tramite l'Electronic Flight Folder per effettuare piccoli cambi di quota.
Un test pilota con Cathay Pacific su oltre 100 voli ha stimato una riduzione del 40% dell'effetto di riscaldamento associato alle scie.

Un test su scala più ampia condotto nel 2026 con American Airlines su oltre 2.400 voli transatlantici ha registrato un tasso di formazione delle scie inferiore del 62% nei voli che hanno seguito il piano.
Le variazioni di quota mirano a colpire esclusivamente le scie persistenti che intrappolano il calore, valutando l'impatto sui consumi di carburante.

items.title: Intervista ad Aldair sulla Roma attuale e il suo passato
items.subtitle: Aldair analizza la Roma di Gasperini, il suo stile di gioco e i giovani talenti brasiliani.

items.summary: L'ex difensore della Roma Aldair discute nel dettaglio il momento attuale della squadra giallorossa, lodando la pressione a tutto campo e le soluzioni tattiche del tecnico. Analizza inoltre il suo stile di gioco difensivo passato, i compagni storici come Totti e i nuovi prospetti del calcio brasiliano.
bullets: La Roma attuale viene indicata come seria contendente per lo scudetto insieme all'Inter, grazie a una migliore condizione fisica e mentale
Il sistema di gioco di Gasperini richiede una pressione a tutto campo molto complessa da mantenere per l'intera partita
Aldair riconosce il valore difensivo attuale di N'Dicka, Mancini ed Hermoso
Ricorda la votazione nello spogliatoio che portò alla decisione di cedere la fascia di capitano a Francesco Totti
Segnala il diciassettenne Iago Machado del Corinthians come nuovo difensore brasiliano da seguire

items.title: Roma-Inter e il nuovo corso di Gasperini
items.subtitle: Analisi dei dati tattici della Roma e del confronto diretto con l'Inter
items.original_title: La Roma contro il tabù Inter: l’ultima vittoria nel 2016. A Trigoria bandita la parola scudetto, ma…
items.summary: L'articolo analizza l'avvio di stagione della Roma sotto la guida di Gian Piero Gasperini, confrontando i dati offensivi e di possesso rispetto alla passata stagione. Viene esaminata la crescita della squadra, che si trova nei piani alti della classifica nonostante una rosa corta, in vista della difficile sfida contro l'Inter.
bullets: I dati delle prime quattro giornate mostrano una media gol salita da 0,7 a 3 a partita, con 85 tiri totali contro i 50 precedenti.
Gli ingressi nell'area avversaria sono passati da 220 a 270, evidenziando una squadra più prolifica e dominante nel possesso.
Gian Piero Gasperini punta a competere per i massimi traguardi nel suo triennio romano, pur gestendo una rosa limitata numericamente.
La Roma non vince contro l'Inter dal 2016 e Gasperini è reduce da dieci sconfitte consecutive contro i nerazzurri.

items.title: La gestione della rosa e le strategie di turnover di Chivu nell'Inter
items.subtitle: Analisi delle rotazioni sistematiche e dei cambi previsti per la sfida contro la Roma
items.original_title: Chivu e la regola del turnover: cinque novità contro la Roma
items.summary: L'allenatore dell'Inter Chivu sta attuando un rigoroso turnover per gestire la doppia competizione e mantenere alta la competitività della rosa. Nelle prime gare le sostituzioni nell'undici titolare sono variate da un minimo di tre fino a cinque cambi per partita. Anche in vista del prossimo match contro la Roma sono previste numerose novità di formazione.
bullets: Il turnover sistematico è imposto dalla qualità e profondità della rosa a disposizione di Chivu per gestire sia la Serie A che la Champions League.
Nelle prime uscite stagionali le rotazioni non sono mai scese sotto i tre cambi rispetto alla partita precedente, arrivando a quota cinque tra le sfide contro Real Madrid e Udinese.
Solo tre giocatori sono stati impiegati sempre da titolari: Barella, Bastoni e Martinez (quest'ultimo escluso solo per un errore recente a beneficio di Provedel).
Per la prossima trasferta contro la Roma sono certi i ritorni dal primo minuto di Lautaro e Dimarco, oltre all'impiego di Bisseck in difesa.
A centrocampo e sulla fascia destra persistono i ballottaggi tra Jones e Sucic, e tra Diouf e Luis Henrique.

items.title: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust
items.subtitle: How a single engineer used AI agents to rewrite 800k lines of TS to Rust
items.original_title: Migrating the GitHub Copilot runtime to Rust, using Copilot
items.summary: The GitHub Copilot agent runtime was migrated from TypeScript on Node.js to over 800,000 lines of production Rust. Completed primarily by a single developer using AI agents over a few months, the rewrite eliminated process-boundary overhead, reduced memory usage, and improved runtime performance by orders of magnitude while shipping continuously via an in-place component-by-component strategy.
bullets: Replaced the V8/Node.js runtime stack to eliminate the roughly 100 MB per-client working set overhead and out-of-process JSON-RPC communication bottlenecks.
Used an in-place, atomic component-by-component porting strategy across 135 incremental releases rather than a risky big-bang rewrite or multi-version branching.
Leveraged the napi-rs crate with threadsafe functions for temporary bidirectional interop between Rust and TypeScript during the migration.
Exposed a stable C ABI with only 19 exported functions that maps to 364 internal JSON-RPC dispatch routes, enabling lightweight in-process hosting across six SDK languages.

items.title: Using Multi-Agent Workflows to Prepare 3D Scenes for Robotics Simulation
items.subtitle: Build agentic pipelines to convert Blender scenes into simulation-ready OpenUSD worlds.
items.original_title: How to Use AI Agents to Prepare 3D Scenes for Simulation
items.summary: This piece outlines an agentic workflow using an orchestrator like GPT-6 Astra, specialized Hermes subagents via NVIDIA NemoClaw, and NVIDIA Omniverse Libraries to automate 3D scene preparation. The system inspects Blender scenes, authors semantic labels, configures physics and sensors, and validates results against SimReady profiles for handoff to Isaac Sim or Isaac Lab.
bullets: Uses Blender MCP (Model Context Protocol) to programmatically inventory objects, transforms, materials, and lights without manual exports.
Employs OpenUSD as a layered, non-destructive simulation contract to store metadata, physics, and sensor configurations.
Utilizes specialized subagents to auto-tag semantic labels like bins, obstacles, and robot targets while flagging ambiguities for human review.
Applies ovphysx to generate collision meshes, assign rigid body properties, mass, and friction parameters.
Leverages ovrtx for visual preflight rendering to verify camera views, lighting, and target visibility before running simulations.
Enforces a SimReady validation gate to check assets against target profiles and automatically repair safe structural issues.

items.title: Editor-Tested Running Shoes Under $130

items.original_title: Save Big Without Sacrificing Comfort With These Editor-Tested Running Shoes Under $130
items.summary: This guide reviews affordable running shoes priced under $130, breaking down how budget models compromise on materials like high-end foams while offering reliable alternatives. It categorizes top-performing shoes for specific use cases such as speedwork, stability, long runs, and trail running based on tester evaluations.
bullets: Budget running shoes under $130 often use older midsole foam technology or standard EVA instead of proprietary premium compounds to cut costs.
New Balance Fresh Foam 680v9 ($85) features a moderate cushion, 8mm drop, and 29mm stack height, making it a reliable everyday trainer compared to the premium Fresh Foam X 880v15.
Brooks Launch 12 utilizes DNA Flash v2 nitrogen-infused supercritical foam for speedwork, though testers noted a narrow midfoot fit.
Asics GT-1000 15 incorporates a 3D Guidance System and Ahar rubber for stability and durability without rigid foam inserts.
Anta C202 7 offers a full-length carbon-fiber plate and TPU supercritical DAN foam for $130, providing an affordable race-day option.
Saucony Excursion TR17 trail shoe features 4.5mm lugs and Versarun cushioning for debris and impact absorption, though it runs small and heavy.

items.title: TensorRT Edge-LLM Completes MLPerf Edge Agentic Benchmark 6.4x Faster on Jetson AGX Thor
items.subtitle: How NVFP4, KV cache reuse, and tree-MTP accelerate edge LLM inference.
items.original_title: TensorRT Edge-LLM Completes the MLPerf Edge Agentic Benchmark 6.4x Faster on Jetson AGX Thor
items.summary: NVIDIA TensorRT Edge-LLM ran the Qwen3.6-27B model on a Jetson AGX Thor Developer Kit, completing the MLPerf Edge Agentic benchmark 6.4x faster than the llama.cpp reference. The speedup relies on NVFP4 quantization, prefix KV cache reuse across expanding agent turns, and tree-based multi-token prediction.
bullets: Achieved 52.33 tokens per second and completed the 1,007-turn workload in 24 minutes and 36 seconds using a single Jetson AGX Thor.
Employs NVFP4 quantization for weights and activations alongside FP8 KV cache to minimize DRAM bandwidth bottlenecks during low-batch decoding.
Reuses attention KV pages and recurrent states for approximately 96% of prompt tokens, reducing prefill to only the new suffix in each agent turn.
Implements tree-based multi-token prediction using 8 draft steps, top-2 candidates, and a 16-node verification tree to gain ~40% higher decoding performance over linear MTP.

items.title: The evolution of Agility Robotics' Digit humanoid
items.subtitle: Trace the engineering journey from Cassie to the human-safe Digit 5.
items.original_title: The evolution of Digit: Agility Robotics’ journey from Cassie to Digit 5
items.summary: Agility Robotics has evolved its bipedal hardware over a decade, moving from fast ostrich-legged research platforms like Cassie to warehouse-ready humanoids like Digit 5. The latest generation shifts focus from speed to strength, featuring anthropomorphic legs, extended battery life, and dynamic safety systems for working closely alongside humans.
bullets: Cassie (2016) was an R&D bipedal platform optimized for running, setting a 100m Guinness World Record in 2022.
Digit 1 (2017) and Digit 3 (2019) initiated commercialization efforts, targeting package delivery and 40 lb box stacking.
Digit 4 (2023) introduced specialized end-effectors for logistics deployments with partners like Amazon, Toyota, and GXO.
Digit 5 transitions from bird-like legs to human-like legs, prioritizing raw strength and payload capacity over sheer speed.
Digit 5 implements dynamic safety behaviors, slowing down or stopping when humans approach without requiring roped-off zones.

items.title: Samarkand Olympiad Day 1: Favourites, fireworks and a shock
items.subtitle: Results and upsets from the opening round of the Samarkand Chess Olympiad
items.original_title: Samarkand Olympiad Day 1: Favourites, fireworks and a shock
items.summary: The 46th Chess Olympiad began in Samarkand with dominant performances from top seeds, though early rounds featured notable surprises. Top-rated teams largely secured comfortable wins, but India's Arjun Erigaisi suffered a major upset defeat against Thailand's Prin Laohawirapap after a late-game tactical blunder. Meanwhile, Botswana held Brazil to a 2-2 draw, and 12-year-old Faustino Oro secured a quick win leading Argentina's squad.
bullets: The 46th Chess Olympiad opened in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, featuring 207 teams in the Open section and 191 in the Women's section.
The United States defeated Iraq 3.5-0.5, resting Fabiano Caruana while Hans Niemann won his US debut in 23 moves.
Thailand's Prin Laohawirapap defeated India's Arjun Erigaisi on board one after Erigaisi blundered with 50.Qg7?? in a time-trouble endgame.
Botswana achieved a major 2-2 draw against Brazil despite being outrated by more than 400 points per board.
Twelve-year-old Faustino Oro led Argentina with a 22-move win on the top board in a 4-0 victory against Kenya.
Top-seeded teams in the Women's section—including India, Georgia, Kazakhstan, China, and the United States—all secured clean 4-0 sweeps.

items.title: Rethinking Robot Safety in the Age of AI
items.subtitle: How adversarial attacks exploit perception, models, and firmware in physical AI robots.
items.original_title: Rethinking Robot Safety in the Age of AI
items.summary: Physical AI introduces security vulnerabilities where external attackers can manipulate what a robot perceives, decides, or executes without triggering traditional component failures. Research demonstrates that backdoors in Vision-Language-Action models, wireless exploit chains like UniPwn, and runtime prompt injections can drive robots into unsafe behaviors while underlying systems appear functional. Mitigating these risks requires extending safety frameworks to include lifecycle cybersecurity, pre-deployment simulation testing, and runtime behavioral monitoring.
bullets: BadVLA and GoBA research demonstrate backdoor attacks on Vision-Language-Action models achieving a 97 percent attack success rate using hidden triggers like coffee mugs without degrading clean performance.
The UniPwn Bluetooth exploit chain allows root-level execution and wormable fleet-wide compromise on humanoid and quadruped robots using hardcoded cryptographic keys.
Vulnerabilities in middleware like ROS 2 and DDS-based systems enable arbitrary code execution and command injection without altering the core AI model architecture.
Runtime attacks such as RoboPAIR and VLAttack use adversarial prompts and visual patches to redirect LLM-controlled robots into unsafe trajectories or drop success rates to zero.
FreezeVLA demonstrates that a single adversarial image can freeze a robot decision-making loop, rendering it unresponsive to subsequent instructions while sensors remain technically functional.
Effective physical AI security requires lifecycle assurance combining model and vulnerability scanning, simulation-based testing, and continuous runtime behavioral-impact assessment.

items.title: Tested Running Headphones
items.subtitle: Performance, battery life, and fit specs for top running headphones.
items.original_title: The 10 Best Running Headphones to Keep You Motivated
items.summary: This review evaluates running headphones across multiple form factors, including open-ear, bone-conduction, earbuds, and over-ear designs. It details battery longevity, waterproofing ratings, connectivity ranges, and acoustic performance tested under real-world conditions.
bullets: Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 utilizes dual drivers blending bone-conduction highs with air-conduction bass, delivering 12 hours of battery life and an open-ear design for traffic awareness.
JLab Go Sport+ provides IP55 sweat resistance and a total of 35 hours of battery via its charging case for under $30, though audio quality leans tinny.
Beyerdynamic Amiron Zero Ultra features Bluetooth 5.4 with a 15-meter range and dynamic drivers tuned from 20 Hz to 20 kHz, prioritizing clarity over heavy bass.
Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 offers up to 45 hours of total battery life with the charging case and IPX4 water resistance, featuring secure earhooks and balanced sound.
H2O Audio Tri 2 Pro is rated IPX8 for deep water submersion and includes 8 GB of internal storage for offline playback without a phone.
Testing criteria prioritized sweat resistance, secure fit during high-impact movement, battery duration for long endurance efforts, and ambient awareness features.

items.title: Translating CUDA Tile Operations from Python to Rust Using Agentic AI
items.subtitle: Porting GPU kernels to cuTile Rust using a multi-agent pipeline and shared Tile IR.
items.original_title: Translating CUDA Tile Operations from Python to Rust Using Agentic AI
items.summary: Engineers built an automated multi-agent pipeline to translate 24 production CUDA tile operators written in Python and Triton into cuTile Rust. By leveraging a shared CUDA Tile IR and mechanical structural diffing, the system generates safe AOT-compiled Rust kernels that achieve 99.5% of reference performance on average. The workflow relies on strict artifact contracts, specialized subagents, and isolated correctness and performance checks.
bullets: All three front ends (cuTile Python, Triton-TileIR, and cuTile Rust) compile through the same tileiras compiler into the cuda_tile IR dialect, enabling direct structural IR diffing before code execution.
A bounded multi-agent state machine handles analysis, kernel authoring, FFI integration, and benchmarking, with subagents communicating strictly via fixed-schema artifacts and validator scripts.

Transitioning from implicit JIT specialization in Python to explicit AOT const-generics in Rust requires expanding untaken branches and explicitly mapping layouts like TMA-backed partition views and reductions.
The C-ABI layer uses a zero-copy pointer-borrowing pattern via ManuallyDrop tensors, allowing Rust kernels to execute asynchronously on Python/PyTorch CUDA streams.
Across 347 paired configurations on NVIDIA DGX B200 hardware, the translated cuTile Rust operators reached a geometric mean performance of 99.5% compared to the Python references.

items.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and GB300 NVL72 MLPerf Inference Performance
items.subtitle: MLPerf Inference v6.1 benchmarks for Vera Rubin NVL72 and GB300 NVL72 systems.
items.original_title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Delivers Leading Performance in MLPerf Inference v6.1 Debut
items.summary: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin NVL72 system debuted in MLPerf Inference v6.1, delivering up to 3.7x higher throughput than the GB300 NVL72 on Qwen3-VL and 2.5x higher throughput on DeepSeek-R1. The architecture utilizes enhanced Tensor Cores, NVFP4 precision, disaggregated serving, and sixth-generation NVLink. Additionally, a four-rack GB300 NVL72 setup demonstrated 99% scaling efficiency across 288 GPUs.
bullets: Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 3.7x better throughput than GB300 NVL72 on Qwen3-VL using vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo.
On DeepSeek-R1, Vera Rubin NVL72 achieved up to 2.5x higher throughput than GB300 NVL72 using TensorRT-LLM.
Hardware and software codesign uses NVFP4 precision to reduce memory footprint across weights, attention, and KV cache.
A 288-GPU submission across four GB300 NVL72 racks achieved 99% scaling efficiency in the offline DSR1 scenario.
Sixth-generation NVLink and NVLink Switch deliver 10x higher packet rates and 3x lower latency than off-the-shelf Ethernet.
Vera Rubin NVL72 achieved 30x better performance than GB300 NVL72 in preview testing on the SemiAnalysis AgentX benchmark.

items.title: FIDE Council Threatens Congress Relocation Over Visa Denials
items.subtitle: FIDE Council warns of Congress relocation due to missing delegate visas.
items.original_title: FIDE Council Statement on visa issues for delegates of the FIDE Congress
items.summary: The FIDE Council has announced that the upcoming FIDE Congress may be relocated to a different date and location if visa issues prevent eligible delegates and council members from attending. Several participants, including voting delegates and FIDE Council member Benard Wanjala, have not yet received their necessary entry visas for Uzbekistan. FIDE insists the Congress can only proceed if all entitled members are guaranteed the ability to exercise their rights.
bullets: The 2026 Chess Olympiad has begun in Samarkand, organized alongside the Uzbekistan Chess Federation.
Multiple players and FIDE Congress participants, including voting delegates, have not received their visas.
FIDE Council member Benard Wanjala is among those currently affected by the visa delays.
The FIDE Council stated that the Congress requires conditions where all eligible persons can participate and vote.
FIDE reserves the right to relocate the Congress to another date and location if delegate rights are not guaranteed.

items.title: NASA Sea Level Projection Tool: come funziona e proiezioni al 2150
items.subtitle: Analisi delle proiezioni NASA sull'innalzamento del mare basate sui dati IPCC
items.original_title: Come sapere quanto si alzerà il livello del mare nel 2150 con il Tool NASA Sea Level Projection
items.summary: Il Sea Level Projection Tool della NASA è un'applicazione interattiva che traduce complessi calcoli fisici in stime locali sull'innalzamento del mare fino al 2150. Lo strumento scompone le previsioni in base a specifici processi fisici e utilizza gli scenari socioeconomici del sesto rapporto IPCC.
bullets: L'applicazione interattiva permette di esplorare l'andamento del livello del mare dal 2020 al 2150 per qualsiasi punto della costa o dell'oceano.
Il modello scompone l'innalzamento nei suoi motori fisici principali, tra cui l'espansione termica, la fusione dei ghiacciai e la circolazione oceanica.
I dati derivano dal Sesto Rapporto di Valutazione (AR6) dell'IPCC pubblicato ad agosto 2021.
Le proiezioni variano in base agli scenari di emissione, dallo scenario virtuoso SSP1-1.9 allo scenario peggiore basato sui combustibili fossili SSP5-8.5.
Per il 2150 il modello prevede aumenti di circa 1 metro a Civitavecchia e Trieste, 1,05 metri a Palermo e Napoli, e 1,15 metri a Venezia.

items.title: The Runner’s World Guide to Heart Rate Training Zones
items.subtitle: Learn the 5 heart rate zones, how to calculate them, and how to structure training.
items.original_title: The Runner’s World Guide to Heart Rate Training Zones
items.summary: This guide details the five-zone heart rate training model, breaking down physiological responses and appropriate efforts from recovery runs to maximal sprints. It explains methods for calculating individual thresholds, ranging from field tests to lab assessments, and details how external factors influence heart rate data.
bullets: Zone 1 (50-60% max HR): Extremely relaxed effort focused on aerobic development and recovery.
Zone 2 (60-70% max HR): Light, conversational effort where runners should spend the majority of their volume.
Zone 3 (70-80% max HR): Moderate or 'gray zone' effort that boosts lactate threshold and glycogen storage when used selectively.
Zone 4 (80-90% max HR): Hard, threshold effort used in interval training to delay lactate accumulation.
Zone 5 (90-100% max HR): Maximum effort sustainable for short intervals under five minutes during speedwork.
Methods to determine zones include VO2 max lab tests, field run tests based on lactate threshold, mathematical formulas, and wearable monitors.

items.title: Emerald AI, Google, and NVIDIA Launch AI Energy Management Alliance
items.subtitle: Forming an alliance for grid-responsive AI data centers to manage power dynamically.
items.original_title: Emerald AI, Google and NVIDIA Launch Alliance to Advance Flexible AI Data Centers
items.summary: Emerald AI, Google, and NVIDIA have launched the AI Energy Management Alliance (AEMA) to develop data centers that dynamically adjust electricity consumption based on grid conditions. The coalition aims to bypass traditional flat-demand infrastructure constraints by establishing performance-based standards for workload shifting, local storage discharge, and emergency response.
bullets: AEMA focuses on performance-based metrics like response speed, duration, and predictability rather than specific hardware.
Flexible data centers adjust electricity draw by shifting computing workloads, utilizing paired generation, and discharging storage.
The alliance establishes rules for ride-through capabilities, curtailment, and contingency responses prior to connection.
Interconnection cost allocation will be reformed to account for actual system benefits and avoided grid upgrades.
The initiative brings together AI platforms, utilities, and regional grid operators to create standardized operational data-sharing frameworks.

items.title: OpenAI Introduces AI-Powered Advertising Platform Features
items.subtitle: New tools bring conversational sponsored agents and natural language ad management to ChatGPT.
items.original_title: Reimagining advertising with AI
items.summary: OpenAI is rolling out new AI-driven advertising capabilities in ChatGPT, introducing Sponsored Agents for interactive user conversations and natural language prompt tools for campaign management. The platform also integrates with HubSpot and Shopify to allow businesses to create, manage, and track ads directly from their existing CRM and ecommerce tools.
bullets: Sponsored Agents allow users to click an ad in ChatGPT and start a distinct, interactive conversation with a business-sponsored agent to ask product questions.
The Ads Manager plugin enables advertisers to create, update, and analyze campaigns directly in ChatGPT using natural language prompts.
AI assistance in Ads Manager automatically suggests copy and imagery based on landing pages and campaign objectives, with manual review controls.
AI-powered text customization adapts existing headlines and descriptions to conversational contexts and translates copy into the user's preferred language.
HubSpot integration allows businesses to connect accounts, create ads, track performance, and manage leads using existing CRM data.
Shopify integration enables US-based merchants to use a dedicated app to run ad campaigns and track performance via Shopify Catalog integrations.

items.title: Building the Materials Foundation for AI
items.subtitle: How advanced specialty materials and AI discovery agents enable next-gen infrastructure.
items.original_title: Building the materials foundation for AI
items.summary: The AI boom pushes data centers and semiconductor manufacturing to physical limits regarding heat, voltage, and purity, requiring advanced specialty materials. Companies like Syensqo are utilizing AI agents and physics-based simulations to rapidly screen millions of potential molecular structures, shrinking the discovery pipeline to target sustainable, high-performance solutions.
bullets: Semiconductor manufacturing and high-voltage data centers require materials that simultaneously handle high temperatures, purity, chemical resistance, and electrical performance.
Data center architectures are shifting toward high-voltage designs and direct immersion cooling to manage exponentially higher power and thermal densities.
Cross-industry transfer allows materials developed for electric vehicles, such as battery binders and thermal components, to be adapted for data center energy storage and power distribution.
Syensqo applies Microsoft's AI discovery tools and physics-based simulation agents to digitally evaluate millions of molecular combinations for performance, toxicity, and sustainability.
AI agents narrow down millions of potential molecules to a prioritized list of roughly one hundred candidates for physical laboratory synthesis.

items.title: The Download: AI's trillion-dollar gamble and OpenAI's biology data bid
items.subtitle: Analysis of AI infrastructure spending, medical datasets, and regulatory updates.
items.original_title: The Download: AI’s trillion-dollar gamble and OpenAI’s biology data bid
items.summary: Financial models show massive productivity gains are required to justify a projected $1.1 trillion AI infrastructure spend by 2027. Meanwhile, the OpenAI Foundation is funding an initiative to acquire proprietary datasets from failed biotech companies for medical AI training.
bullets: Hyperscalers are projected to spend nearly $1.1 trillion on AI data centers through 2027.
Finance professor Jessica Wachter calculates that AI companies need unprecedented productivity growth to break even by 2030.
The OpenAI Foundation is funding an effort by policy analyst Ruxandra Teslo to salvage regulatory and manufacturing data from bankrupt biotech firms.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg have publicly rejected calls for coordinated AI slowdowns and new safety laws.
A Chinese hacking firm utilized AI tools to convert stolen government data into structured intelligence reports.

items.title: FIDE Issues Reimbursements Following 2026 Chess Olympiad Accommodation Failures
items.subtitle: FIDE reimburses teams forced to self-fund rooms due to local organizing committee failures.
items.original_title: FIDE Statement on accommodation issues at the 2026 Chess Olympiad
items.summary: FIDE announced financial compensation and reimbursements for national teams affected by severe accommodation shortages and substandard lodging during the first days of the 2026 Chess Olympiad. Although accommodation logistics were managed by the local Organizing Committee, FIDE secured alternative funds to cover up to three days of self-arranged rooms and issued compensatory payments for stays in below-standard official hotels.
bullets: Shortcomings by the local Organizing Committee left multiple teams without proper lodging on the first day of the 2026 Chess Olympiad.
Affected teams forced to rent rooms in the city at their own expense will be fully reimbursed by FIDE for up to three days of appropriate-standard accommodation.
Teams required to stay in official hotels that failed to meet FIDE-approved standards will receive additional compensatory payments.
FIDE stated that while it lacks direct authority over local accommodation arrangements, it intervened to prevent participating federations from suffering financial losses.

items.title: La rivoluzione iraniana oltre la guerra
items.subtitle: La regista Raha Shirazi racconta i cinquanta anni di resistenza femminile in Iran.
items.original_title: Quattro anni dopo l’uccisione di Mahsa Amini, la rivoluzione iraniana non si ferma. Intervista a Raha Shirazi, regista di “A war on women”
items.summary: A quattro anni dall'uccisione di Mahsa Amini, la regista Raha Shirazi analizza nel documentario "A war on women" le radici profonde del movimento Donna, Vita, Libertà. L'intervista evidenzia come la resistenza delle donne iraniane non si sia fermata nonostante la repressione statale e i recenti conflitti geopolitici che hanno distratto l'attenzione internazionale.
bullets: Il movimento Donna, Vita, Libertà affonda le sue radici in decenni di disobbedienza quotidiana e non è nato improvvisamente nel 2022.
Per la prima volta nella storia iraniana, gli uomini hanno partecipato massicciamente alle proteste, trasformando la libertà delle donne nel cardine della liberazione dell'intera società.
La nuova generazione di donne iraniane rifiuta categoricamente l'etichetta di vittima e rivendica la totale proprietà del proprio corpo e della propria voce.
I conflitti armati e l'attenzione internazionale polarizzata hanno offerto al regime una copertura strategica per intensificare arresti ed esecuzioni lontani dai riflettori.
La rivoluzione iraniana sopravvive non solo nelle grandi manifestazioni di piazza, ma nella quotidiana disobbedienza civile e nel rifiuto sistemico delle imposizioni del regime.

items.title: Gerrei Astrofest 2026
items.subtitle: Attività e laboratori di astronomia, radiotelescopi e esplorazione spaziale a Sant'Andrea Frius
items.original_title: Gerrei Astrofest 2026
items.summary: La quarta edizione del Gerrei Astrofest, organizzata dall'INAF di Cagliari con INFN, ASI e CICAP, si terrà il 19 settembre 2026 a Sant'Andrea Frius. L'evento offre laboratori pratici, dimostrazioni scientifiche e osservazioni astronomiche per avvicinare il pubblico alla ricerca spaziale e alle grandi infrastrutture scientifiche sarde.
bullets: Il laboratorio ASI illustra le comunicazioni spaziali con onde radio e il ruolo delle antenne di terra per sonde come Voyager I e Cassini-Huygens.
Il Dipartimento di Fisica dell'Università di Cagliari, INFN e INAF presentano esperimenti sulla gravità e le onde gravitazionali legati al progetto dell'Einstein Telescope.
L'INAF espone il furgone caccia-interferenze utilizzato per individuare i disturbi radio e preservare il silenzio radio necessario al Sardinia Radio Telescope.
Sono previste postazioni per l'osservazione solare tramite telescopio ottico e sessioni serali di osservazione astronomica guidate dai ricercatori.

items.title: Un giorno in pretura e l’etica della cronaca nera
items.subtitle: Come un format giudiziario ha cambiato la narrazione mediatica del crimine.
items.original_title: “Un giorno in pretura” ha cambiato il modo in cui guardiamo alla cronaca nera
items.summary: Il programma televisivo "Un giorno in pretura" rappresenta un modello unico nel panorama della cronaca nera italiana, fondato su un montaggio rigoroso e sull'assenza di spettacolarizzazione. Attraverso le riprese fisse nelle aule di tribunale, la trasmissione offre una riflessione profonda sui meccanismi della giustizia e sulla natura umana.
bullets: Il programma evita la spettacolarizzazione e la morbosità tipica del true-crime contemporaneo, mostrando i processi con una regia fissa e distaccata.
La conduzione di Roberta Petrelluzzi si distingue per sobrietà e rigore istituzionale, offrendo strumenti di decodificazione scevri da pregiudizi.
Nato sotto la direzione di Angelo Guglielmi a Rai 3, il format incarna l'idea di televisione pubblica come servizio e specchio della società.
L'evoluzione del Codice di Procedura Penale del 1989 ha trasformato la struttura del programma, portandolo a documentare grandi inchieste storiche come Tangentopoli e i maxiprocessi.
Il passaggio alla seconda serata e l'avvento di piattaforme come RaiPlay hanno modificato la fruizione del pubblico, oscillando tra la riscoperta cult e la riduzione dei tempi narrativi.

items.title: La gestione della rosa di Gasperini alla Roma

items.original_title: Roma, la fiducia e il coraggio
items.summary: Gian Piero Gasperini sta guidando la Roma sfruttando l'intera rosa attraverso cambi sistematici e coraggiosi. Nonostante una rosa considerata corta per la Champions League, la squadra ha ottenuto quattro vittorie consecutive in campionato grazie al contributo determinante delle alternative.
bullets: Gasperini ha dimostrato di non avere titolari fissi, sostituendo giocatori chiave come Dybala e Malen a partita in corso.
Nelle vittorie contro Atalanta e Torino, i cambi effettuati dalla panchina hanno cambiato l'inerzia tattica delle gare.
La strategia delle cinque sostituzioni viene sfruttata regolarmente per mantenere alta l'intensità e coinvolgere l'intero spogliatoio.
La squadra ha raggiunto quota 12 punti in classifica, confermando l'efficacia della gestione delle risorse da parte del tecnico.

items.title: False dicotomie e complessità nell'evoluzione
items.subtitle: Superare le divisioni rigide per riscoprire la complessità scientifica.
items.original_title: Elisabeth Vrba: la moschettiera dell’evoluzione
items.summary: Il pensiero di Stephen Jay Gould ci invita a superare le false dicotomie, come quelle tra natura e cultura o tra geni e ambiente. Abbandonare schemi in bianco e nero permette di cogliere la complessità reale della scienza e dell'evoluzione.
bullets: La tendenza a pensare in termini di rigide dicotomie inganna la comprensione dei fenomeni naturali e culturali.
Stephen Jay Gould spinge a superare contrapposizioni fuorvianti come geni versus ambiente.
La riscoperta della complessità richiede di accettare sfumature che spesso faticano ad avere grande risonanza mediatica.

La percentuale realizzativa attuale è ferma al 18%, evidenziando margini di miglioramento.

Il rendimento attuale candida il difensore argentino per un posto da titolare nella prossima partita contro l'Inter.

Presenza di alternative valide in panchina che permettono di mantenere alto il livello della squadra a partita in corso.

items.title: University of Manchester Uses NVIDIA Earth-2 to Forecast Air Pollution Across the UK
items.subtitle: How generative AI models accelerate UK air pollution forecasting from days to hours
items.original_title: University of Manchester Uses NVIDIA Earth-2 to Forecast Air Pollution Across the UK
items.summary: Researchers at the University of Manchester have adapted NVIDIA's Earth-2 climate and weather AI framework to model U.K. air pollution at a 2-3 square kilometer resolution. By training the CorrDiff generative downscaling model on the Isambard-AI supercomputer and running inference on desktop hardware, the team achieved significant compute efficiencies while avoiding the high costs of traditional chemistry-based models.
bullets: Traditional chemistry-based air quality models are computationally expensive and slow when incorporating full chemical simulations.
The team used a year's worth of hourly U.K. pollution data to train the Earth-2 CorrDiff generative downscaling model.
Training completed in two days on a single eight-GPU node on the Isambard-AI supercomputer.
The team also incorporated Earth-2 StormCast to enable time-dependent forecasts using direct air quality observations.
Inference and smaller training runs were successfully executed on an NVIDIA DGX Spark desktop system.

bullets: Il singolo apripista omonimo è una traccia cruda e diretta di meno di due minuti, pensata per rilanciare il gangsta rap romano.
Il disco è interamente prodotto da Lou Chano, confermando un'intesa artistica che dura da oltre vent'anni.

A 42 anni e con un percorso di vita complesso alle spalle, Zinghero amplia i temi trattati inserendo riflessioni personali, attualità e politica senza rinunciare alla matrice hardcore.

items.title: Salesforce and NVIDIA Release Koa CRM Reasoning Model

items.original_title: ‘Now We Can Know Everything and Do Anything,’ Jensen Huang Says at Dreamforce
items.summary: Salesforce and NVIDIA have announced Koa, Salesforce's first CRM reasoning model built using NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super and a proprietary synthetic dataset. The model was fine-tuned using supervised learning and reinforcement learning, allowing it to run entirely on Salesforce infrastructure without exposing customer data. In benchmark testing, Koa matches or exceeds leading model performance on CRM tasks with significantly fewer errors.
bullets: Koa is built by post-training NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super on a synthetic dataset derived from nearly three decades of enterprise CRM deployments.
Training utilized NVIDIA NeMo RL, NeMo Gym, and NeMo AutoModel across synthetic scenarios spanning more than 14 industries.
Salesforce controls the model weights, runs the system entirely on its own infrastructure, and trains it without using customer data.
On Salesforce's CRM Bench, Koa matches or exceeds leading model performance while generating three times fewer errors on CRM actions.
The model is currently powering an employee agent in Slack, entering customer pilots in October 2024, and targeting general availability in winter 2026.

The Czech Republic beat Israel 2.5-1.5, driven by Anna Ryvova's victory over Aleksandra Aleksandrova on Board 4.

The Philippines, Cuba, and IBCA trail closely behind the leaders with 8 match points each.

items.title: What Happened to the College Party? On Some Campuses, Gen Z Would Rather Run
items.subtitle: How a student-run running club in Florida built a sober weekend social model.
items.original_title: What Happened to the College Party? On Some Campuses, Gen Z Would Rather Run.
items.summary: At the University of Florida, a run club called Peak Pulse has drawn hundreds of students to alcohol-free weekend morning events that combine running with socializing. Founder Aydan Child scaled the club from small meetups to ticketed events featuring DJs and cold plunges, proving strong demand for fitness-based community spaces that do not revolve around drinking.
bullets: Peak Pulse started as an informal weekly run club in Gainesville to create social opportunities without defaulting to alcohol.
Events incorporate a 20-minute pre-run socializing window, followed by a run open to all paces with a motto of "Run, Walk, or Crawl."
Early events funded out of pocket transitioned to a $10 ticket model, drawing around 300 paying attendees to test demand.
The club has expanded to chapters in Tallahassee, Orlando, Boca Raton, and the Florida Keys, attracting interest from fraternities, sororities, and local venues.
Participants emphasize that the club functions as a community space rather than a dating scene or a replacement for traditional nightlife.

items.title: Breaking the Sub-4 Marathon with Tempo Runs
items.subtitle: Learn how incorporating tempo and threshold runs builds physical speed and mental toughness.
items.original_title: I Hadn’t Hit My Marathon Time Goal for Years. After Adding This Run to My Training, I Finally Smashed Sub-4.
items.summary: A runner details how transitioning from a moderate, one-pace training schedule to include structured tempo and threshold runs helped her break the four-hour marathon barrier. By training just below the lactate threshold, she improved both her physiological endurance and her mental capacity to handle discomfort.
bullets: Threshold runs are executed right at the lactate threshold where lactate accumulates faster than the body can clear it, causing fatigue.
Tempo runs target an effort level of about 6 out of 10 on the rate of perceived exertion scale, challenging the runner aerobically without being fully maxed out.
Workouts can be performed as standalone sessions or integrated into long runs, such as a 12-mile run featuring six miles at tempo pace.
Proper form—including keeping the chest tall, shoulders relaxed, and maintaining a rhythmic breath—acts as a ceiling to prevent overworking during faster intervals.
Regular exposure to discomfort trains the psychological response to race-day fatigue, shifting the mindset from avoidance to perseverance.

items.title: Bypassing inference bottlenecks: Accelerating complex AI search with Retrieve-for-Train
items.subtitle: Learn how offline RL and diffusion models accelerate complex AI search query fan-out.
items.original_title: Bypassing inference bottlenecks: Accelerating complex AI search with Retrieve-for-Train
items.summary: Google Research's Retrieve-for-Train framework replaces expensive inference-time reasoning with a one-time offline reinforcement learning process to train a lightweight diffusion model. By optimizing for groundedness, intent alignment, and geometric diversity using the Vendi Score, the system enables single-pass, set-level query decomposition without autoregressive latency penalties.
bullets: Uses offline reinforcement learning once to discover reward-aligned fan-outs and compiles them into supervision for a lightweight diffusion model.
Employs a strict mathematical composite reward balancing groundedness, alignment, and the Vendi Score to prevent reward hacking and semantic collapse.
Evaluated on 4B open-source models (Gemma3-4B and Qwen3-4B) generating 10 sub-queries using Soft-GRPO across fashion and music datasets.
Distills behaviors into a 53.9M-parameter diffusion model that executes in a single non-autoregressive parallel pass in continuous embedding space.
Achieves a 12x to 20x speedup over autoregressive approaches, cutting large context batch latencies from nearly 50 seconds down to sub-second or low-second figures.

bullets: Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking achieved an 82.6 score on Artificial Analysis' Speech to Speech Quality Index, 68.6% on τ-Voice, and 97.7% on Big Bench Audio.
Gemini 3.8 Live processes visual inputs in near real-time and automatically detects and transitions between 97 supported languages mid-conversation.
Both models can execute tools and API calls in the background while maintaining continuous conversational flow and providing verbal progress updates.
Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking reasons and speaks simultaneously, using early verbal cues to manage multi-step background tasks.
Developer integration is supported via the Gemini Live API in partnership with platforms like Agora, LangChain, LiveKit, Pipecat, Vercel, and Vision Agents.
All generated audio is embedded with SynthID watermarks for detection and verification.

items.title: Dense vs. MoE Models: Active Parameters, Throughput, and When to Choose Each
items.subtitle: Learn how dense and MoE architectures differ in throughput, memory, routing, and fine-tuning.
items.original_title: Dense vs. MoE Models: Active Parameters, Throughput, and When to Choose Each
items.summary: Dense models activate all parameters for every token, offering predictable serving and easier fine-tuning. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures route tokens to a subset of feed-forward networks, decoupling memory footprint from active compute to yield higher token throughput at the cost of routing complexity.
bullets: Dense models activate every parameter for every forward pass, while MoE models replace single shared FFN blocks with multiple expert networks and a router.
MoE decouples memory from compute: total parameters dictate VRAM requirements, but active parameters drive FLOPs and token throughput.
Routing decisions occur per layer based on syntax and token-type patterns, while tokens still pass through the full attention mechanism.
At batch size 1, MoE excels because it reads fewer weight bytes per token, though its latency advantage narrows at high concurrency.
Fine-tuning MoEs requires care to avoid unbalancing the router, whereas dense models allow uniform gradient flow.
Quantization must protect sensitive components like routers and linear-attention projections, as small perturbations can flip discrete routing decisions.

items.title: From Megawatts to Tokens: How NVIDIA Maximizes AI Factory Production
items.subtitle: Learn how NVIDIA DSX software increases token throughput and handles grid power constraints.
items.original_title: From Megawatts to Tokens: How NVIDIA Maximizes AI Factory Production
items.summary: NVIDIA introduces its DSX infrastructure platform to maximize AI factory token throughput under fixed power budgets. The system uses real-time dynamic power allocation, automated grid demand response integration, and 800V DC power architectures to reclaim stranded capacity without interrupting high-priority workloads.
bullets: Cloud provider Lambda validated that DSX MaxLPS allows 19 nodes to run within the same power budget as 16 full-power nodes, yielding a 24% increase in token throughput and 23% better performance per watt on HGX B200 servers.

Emerald AI's Conductor platform integrated with NVIDIA DSX Flex successfully automated real-time load shedding during grid constraints, dropping facility power from 4 MW to 3 MW in under a minute without dropping critical jobs.
DSX MaxLPS monitors GPU and rack-level power consumption in real time, dynamically reallocating headroom across nodes to recover stranded capacity.
NVIDIA's upcoming 800V DC power architecture aims to reduce conversion complexity and improve delivery efficiency for denser racks, targeting 3% to 5% end-to-end efficiency gains.
The full DSX platform suite includes DSX Sim for pre-deployment modeling, DSX OS for runtime consistency, and generation-specific reference designs co-designed with ecosystem partners.

items.title: NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Deterministic Execution Drives Power-Efficient High-Interactivity Inference on NVIDIA Vera Rubin
items.subtitle: How deterministic execution and compiler scheduling reduce voltage guardbands to save power
items.original_title: How NVIDIA Groq 3 LPX Deterministic Execution Drives Power-Efficient High-Interactivity Inference on NVIDIA Vera Rubin
items.summary: The NVIDIA Vera Rubin platform integrates Groq 3 LPX accelerators to achieve high-interactivity inference efficiency through a deterministic execution model. By scheduling data movement and compute down to the clock cycle, the LPU compiler predicts electrical current draw, enabling proactive power delivery and clock period synthesis that shrink voltage guardbands.
bullets: NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS software shifts power dynamically between racks, allowing operators to provision up to 40% more GPUs within the same site power envelope.
Rack-level capacitors and Intelligent Power Smoothing software absorb bursty power spikes from training and inference to plan around sustained demand rather than worst-case peaks.
Groq 3 LPX uses a deterministic execution model where a compiler schedules data movement and operations across 256 LPU chips down to the exact clock cycle.
Preemptive Power (PEP) commands the power delivery network to adjust voltage before demand spikes arrive, reducing the voltage drop from decoupling capacitor discharge.
Clock Period Synthesis (CPS) lengthens or shortens specific clock cycles to lower the rate of current change (di/dt) during high-demand operations.
Reducing voltage droop decreases the required electrical safety margin (voltage guardband), yielding low-double-digit percentage power savings without affecting workload execution.

items.title: Your Agent Aced the Task. Will It Do It Again?
items.subtitle: How to measure and fix the consistency gap in LLM agent workflows
items.original_title: Your Agent Aced the Task. Will It Do It Again?
items.summary: LLM agents often suffer from a consistency gap, succeeding on average while failing unpredictably across repeated runs due to flat probability distributions at decision steps. The ALTK-Evolve toolkit introduces a Consistency Analyzer that diagnoses these flip-prone steps using black-box resampling and generates reusable guidelines to halve the consistency gap without sacrificing average accuracy.
bullets: A ReAct agent using GPT-4.1 on AppWorld showed a 24.4-point consistency gap, achieving 77.4% Mean@5 accuracy but succeeding on all 5 runs for only 53.0% of tasks.

The Consistency Analyzer resamples recorded trajectories at decision steps to measure output variance with a single call requesting k completions (k=5), requiring no ground truth or environment re-runs.
Injecting generated consistency guidelines into context halved the consistency gap from 24.4pp to 12.0pp while increasing aggregate Pass^5 from 53.0% to 69.0%.
Medium and hard tasks gained the most from the approach, improving relative success rates by 44% and 45% respectively, with zero degradation in average accuracy.
Guidelines generated from one trajectory generalized to similar tasks, lifting Pass^5 by 13.0pp on related tasks within the same scenario.

items.title: Space Force Integrates AI Tools to Process Growing Volumes of Satellite Data
items.subtitle: How AI automates intelligence workflows and satellite data analysis for the military
items.original_title: More satellites watch the battlefield, putting a premium on making sense of the data
items.summary: As military commands face an explosion of available satellite and geospatial data, the Space Force and its commercial vendors are deploying artificial intelligence to make sense of it. Systems now go beyond basic image retrieval to autonomously track events as they develop and generate operational briefings. Companies like Danti are expanding their deployment across combatant commands via programs like TacSRT.
bullets: Gen. Douglas Schiess noted the Space Force's close operational relationship with the National Reconnaissance Office to provide intelligence capabilities.
AI tools deployed by firms like Danti integrate space-based information with maritime tracking, signals, weather, and open-source data to identify changes.
Capabilities have shifted from search-and-retrieval to advanced operational workflows, such as following developing events and drafting reports.
Software is now used to automate portions of morning intelligence briefings by continuously assessing incoming data and building queryable presentations.
Danti recently secured a $2.1 million Space Force contract expansion under the Tactical Surveillance, Reconnaissance and Tracking (TacSRT) program.
AI-generated reports are explicitly flagged and must be reviewed and approved by human analysts prior to dissemination.

items.title: Il significato filosofico di Coyote vs. Acme
items.subtitle: Analisi del film in cui Willy il Coyote fa causa alla ACME per i fallimenti dei suoi prodotti.
