items.title: Le linee guida del Ministero per l'uso dell'IA a scuola
items.subtitle: Il quadro normativo e tecnico per integrare l'IA nella didattica
items.original_title: L’AI può essere usata a scuola? Cosa dicono le linee guida del Ministero su utilizzo e rischi
items.summary: Il Ministero dell'Istruzione ha pubblicato le linee guida ufficiali per regolamentare l'uso dell'intelligenza artificiale nelle scuole, adottando un approccio antropocentrico e basato sul principio 'human-in-the-loop'. Il documento stabilisce divieti severi per proteggere la privacy dei minori, vieta l'uso dell'IA per le valutazioni automatiche e definisce ruoli e sanzioni, supportati da 100 milioni di euro del PNRR per la formazione.
bullets: Approccio antropocentrico e regola human-in-the-loop: l'IA supporta ma non sostituisce mai l'insegnante nelle decisioni e nelle valutazioni.
Sistemi ad alto rischio: l'uso dell'IA per valutare i risultati di apprendimento o definire i percorsi scolastici è rigidamente limitato e subordinato al giudizio umano.
Divieti tassativi: vietato l'uso di algoritmi per il riconoscimento delle emozioni, la profilazione e la categorizzazione biometrica degli studenti.
Regole di privacy: divieto assoluto di inserire dati personali nei prompt e obbligo di diritto di opt-out per le famiglie rispetto all'addestramento dei modelli.
Finanziamenti PNRR: stanziati 100 milioni di euro tramite il DM 219/2025 per formare docenti e personale ATA in 2.100 scuole italiane.

items.title: Under-35 Innovators Shaping the Future of Biotech
items.subtitle: Reviewing five technical biotech and AI projects from young innovators.
items.original_title: Meet the under-35s shaping the future of biotech
items.summary: This article highlights five young innovators working on distinct biotechnological advancements, ranging from affordable medical devices for postpartum hemorrhage to kirigami-inspired flexible brain electrodes and AI-designed bacteriophages. It details practical applications such as personalized gene-editing therapies for rare genetic disorders and cellular reprogramming for treating age-related vision loss.
bullets: Paschal Kija developed the Mkanda Salama, a $70 device that stopped postpartum bleeding in 73% of women within 20 minutes.
Xiao Yang designed flexible, ultra-small brain electrodes using kirigami paper-cutting principles to minimize tissue damage.
Sarah Grandinette contributed to a personalized gene-editing therapy for a rare genetic disorder, validated in mice and monkeys before human dosing.
Yuancheng Lu helped develop a cellular reprogramming therapy that reversed vision loss in aged mice, now advancing to human clinical trials for eye disease via Life Biosciences.
Samuel King used a generative AI model to design functional bacteriophage DNA blueprints that successfully replicated and infected bacteria.

items.title: Complessa non vuol dire oscura: la poesia di Amelia Rosselli
items.subtitle: Analisi dell'opera di Amelia Rosselli, rifiutando stereotipi biografici e riduzionismi critici.
items.original_title: Complessa non vuol dire oscura: la poesia di Amelia Rosselli
items.summary: La ricezione dell'opera di Amelia Rosselli richiede il superamento di narrazioni deterministiche legate al suicidio e alla malattia mentale. La sua poesia si distingue per una complessità strutturale e metrica che sfugge alla parafrasi lineare, ponendosi come ricerca etica e linguistica irriducibile alle mode o alle etichette di genere.
bullets: Il trentennale della scomparsa e la pubblicazione del Meridiano nel 2012 hanno consolidato la centralità di Rosselli nel canone del Novecento, incrementando la produzione critica.
La poesia rosselliana è definita complessa ma non oscura: il senso non si cela dietro un lessico ermetico, ma emerge dall'intera struttura metrica e formale del testo.

La diagnosi di schizofrenia paranoide e il testo Storia di una malattia impongono un confronto rigoroso con il dolore mentale, evitando tuttavia di ridurlo a mera chiave interpretativa dell'intera produzione artistica.

L'autrice si è sempre distinta dal Gruppo 63 e dalla neovanguardia, rifiutando la riduzione dell'io e fondando una scrittura basata sulla fusione trilingue e sulla ricerca etnomusicologica e strutturalista.
Il lascito di Rosselli consiste in un'etica della scrittura intransigente, che oppone alla semplificazione mediatica e digitale una radicale e irripetibile vocazione alla ricerca.

Riferimento al metodo di Stephen Jay Gould per leggere la complessità.
Analisi della polarizzazione nel dibattito pubblico tra woke e antiwoke.
Invito a superare le semplificazioni ideologiche a favore di un approccio evolutivo.

Gestione dei cartellini insufficiente, con ammonizioni distribuite in modo discutibile e interventi falliti.

items.summary: Il Napoli di Allegri mostra criticità strutturali nella costruzione del gioco e nella tenuta difensiva, acuite dall'assenza di elementi chiave come McTominay e Anguissa. L'impiego contemporaneo di Gilmour, Lobotka e De Bruyne garantisce qualità sulla trequarti ma indebolisce il centrocampo sul piano fisico e della copertura, costringendo i terzini a rischiosissime rivenute in avanti.
bullets: La costruzione si affida alle verticalizzazioni immediate di Gilmour per aggirare i problemi dei difensori centrali e del portiere sotto pressione.
L'inserimento di Kevin De Bruyne sposta il baricentro offensivo ma priva la squadra di centrocampisti capaci di attaccare l'area con costanza e svolgere il box-to-box.
L'avanzamento sistematico dei terzini per occupare i mezzi spazi e riempire l'area lascia la squadra spaccata, esponendola a transizioni avversarie pericolose.
La fase difensiva risente della scarsa applicazione senza palla di De Bruyne e della vulnerabilità dei singoli nei duelli uno contro uno sulle fasce.
Hojlund si conferma fondamentale per ripulire i palloni lunghi e creare superiorità, ma risulta troppo isolato in avanti.

items.title: Intervista ad Ali Asgari sul cinema iraniano
items.subtitle: Il regista Ali Asgari spiega il cinema del fuoricampo e l'uso dell'assurdo di fronte alla repressione.
items.original_title: Abbiamo intervistato Ali Asgari
items.summary: In questa intervista, il regista Ali Asgari discute il passaggio tonale del suo cinema verso la tragedia e il dramma in seguito ai massacri in Iran. Esamina il tema del suicidio e dell'incertezza sociale attraverso la lente filosofica di Albert Camus, riflettendo sul legame storico tra il neorealismo italiano e i cineasti iraniani.
bullets: Il cambiamento di tono stilistico nei film di Asgari riflette il trauma sociale e la tristezza diffusa dopo le violenze e le proteste in Iran.
Il concetto filosofico di suicidio di Albert Camus viene impiegato per descrivere l'incertezza esistenziale e la ricerca di risposte che la vita non fornisce.
La scelta di accettare l'assurdo della vita, anziché soccombere, permette ai personaggi di aggrapparsi ai piccoli dettagli quotidiani e ai legami familiari per continuare a scegliere la vita.
Esiste un legame profondo tra il cinema iraniano e il neorealismo italiano, radicato nell'esperienza condivisa di società segnate da drammi, guerre e repressioni.
Il cinema viene definito come un mezzo per registrare le emozioni umane e documentare le situazioni storiche senza cadere nella retorica dell'attivismo politico diretto.

items.title: Svezia a rischio svolta a destra, l'addio a Emma Bonino e la crisi del vino francese
items.subtitle: La Svezia verso un governo con l'ultradestra, la morte di Emma Bonino e il calo del vino in Francia.
items.original_title: In Svezia l’estrema destra potrebbe arrivare al governo per la prima volta | The Essential
items.summary: La Svezia si avvia a elezioni cruciali con la possibile entrata al governo della destra radicale dei Democratici Svedesi, dopo anni di drastica stretta sull'immigrazione e sulle politiche di sicurezza. Nel frattempo, la politica italiana piange la scomparsa di Emma Bonino, figura storica dei diritti civili ed europeista convinta. Sul fronte agricolo, il cambiamento climatico e le temperature estreme riducono drasticamente la produzione enologica francese, con cali record nella regione dello Champagne e della Borgogna.
bullets: La Svezia ha ridotto del 96% le domande di asilo accettate rispetto al 2015, introducendo restrizioni sui ricongiungimenti e un bonus di rimpatrio fino a 36.000 euro.
Il partito dei Democratici Svedesi, nato da matrici radicali negli anni Ottanta, potrebbe entrare per la prima volta direttamente nel governo svedese.
Emma Bonino è deceduta all'età di 78 anni, lasciando un'eredità politica legata alle battaglie radicali sui diritti civili, sul divorzio, sull'aborto e sull'europeismo.
Il Ministero dell'Agricoltura francese stima un calo del 30% della produzione nazionale di vino a causa del caldo estremo e della siccità.
La produzione di Champagne in Francia rischia di dimezzarsi, mentre la Borgogna registra perdite superiori al 30% aggravate dai rischi legati agli incendi.

items.title: ToolGrad: Efficient tool-use dataset generation with textual gradients
items.subtitle: Learn how ToolGrad reverses dataset generation to create complex LLM tool-use paths.
items.original_title: ToolGrad: Efficient tool-use dataset generation with textual "gradients"
items.summary: ToolGrad addresses the high cost and inefficiency of generating synthetic LLM tool-use datasets by reversing the standard workflow. Instead of generating user queries first and searching for execution paths using trial-and-error depth-first search, ToolGrad generates the ground-truth tool-use chain first and then annotates the corresponding user prompt. The framework adapts textual gradients to iteratively propose, execute, select, and refine API workflows.
bullets: Traditional query-first dataset generation relies on inefficient depth-first search (DFS) agents over large API pools.
ToolGrad uses an answer-first approach, generating the ground-truth tool-use chain first, making the annotation of the user query a single LLM step.
The framework adapts the concept of textual gradients—descriptive feedback from an LLM critic—to iteratively construct valid API workflows from extensive tool libraries.
ToolGrad consists of four sequential modules: propose, execute, select, and update.
Evaluating on ToolBench with over 16,000 real-world APIs, ToolGrad generated complex tool-use data at a lower cost with a near 100% pass rate.
Gemma-3 models fine-tuned on ToolGrad-generated datasets outperformed base models and matched state-of-the-art proprietary models on out-of-distribution benchmarks like BFCL.

items.title: Teradyne Robotics sues JAKA Robotics over Universal Robots patents
items.subtitle: Teradyne targets JAKA's cobots in Europe over three Universal Robots patents.
items.original_title: Teradyne Robotics sues JAKA over 3 Universal Robots patents
items.summary: Teradyne Robotics has filed a patent infringement lawsuit at the Unified Patent Court against JAKA Robotics' German subsidiary. The case targets three Universal Robots patents concerning user interfaces, joint safety brakes, and joint construction. JAKA previously stated it found no potential infringement through its Freedom-to-Operate analyses.
bullets: Teradyne filed the patent infringement case UPC-CFI-0003057/2026 at the UPC Copenhagen Local Division on August 24, 2026.
The lawsuit involves three Universal Robots patents with March 2006 priority dates covering hardware and software features.
Patent EP1996376 covers a programmable robot system and user interface with a touchscreen 3D movement representation.
Patent EP3045273 covers a robot-joint safety brake featuring a solenoid, ratchet, and annular friction member.
Patent EP3530420 covers robot-joint construction aspects like output flanges and adjacent joint connection structures.
This is Teradyne Robotics' second major European legal action against a Chinese robotics company following a February 2026 suit against Elite Robots.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
items.subtitle: Review diffs, run terminal commands, and test UI changes inside the GitHub Copilot app.
items.original_title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Using the diff, terminal, and browser
items.summary: The GitHub Copilot app integrates built-in panels for diffs, terminals, and browsers to streamline the AI coding workflow. Developers can review code changes, execute project scripts, and test user interfaces directly within a single application to close the AI coding loop.
bullets: The diff panel highlights code additions in green and deletions in red, allowing developers to accept modifications, leave comments, or request further changes.
The terminal panel enables running and configuring project scripts, such as starting dev servers, supporting multiple concurrent windows.
The browser panel provides a built-in interface for testing web features and includes a Pick and Polish tool to select and adjust UI elements with the agent.
Changes can be accepted and pull requests created directly inside the app after completing the review, execution, and testing loop.

items.title: Swarmer to Acquire Ratel Robotics for Up to $224M
items.subtitle: Swarmer acquires Ukrainian UGV maker Ratel Robotics to combine ground platforms with AI swarming.
items.original_title: Swarmer to acquire Ukrainian UGV maker Ratel Robotics for up to $224M
items.summary: AI-powered drone software company Swarmer has agreed to acquire Ukrainian uncrewed ground vehicle (UGV) manufacturer Ratel Robotics for up to $224 million in a cash-and-stock deal. The acquisition aims to integrate Ratel's battle-tested ground platforms with Swarmer's multi-domain autonomy software, enabling single operators to coordinate large-scale robotic and aerial swarms.
bullets: The acquisition value reaches up to $224 million including earnout milestones, expanding Swarmer's total headcount to nearly 500 employees.
Ratel Robotics supplies UGVs handling logistics, de-mining, casualty evacuation, strikes, and drone-launch missions for Ukrainian forces.
Ratel's products accounted for roughly 37% of the Ukrainian Ministry of Defense Procurement Agency's UGV spending between January and April 2026, securing $86 million in contracts this year.
Swarmer's vendor-agnostic software currently supports up to 690 drones per swarm, with the combined architecture designed to use UGVs for launching drones and interceptors.
All serial Ratel H and M models carry NATO stock numbers (NCAGE Code A3X8J) and AQAP 2110 quality assurance certificates.

items.title: In Memoriam: Pioneering Engineers in Networking, Cellular, and CAD
items.subtitle: Obituaries of Frank Kuo, Muhammad Rezaul Karim, and Donald Dietmeyer
items.original_title: Codeveloper of Ethernet Predecessor Dies at 91
items.summary: This article highlights the technical contributions of deceased engineering pioneers, detailing their foundational work in packet-switching, early cellular trials, and computer-aided design for integrated circuits. Frank Kuo co-developed ALOHAnet, Muhammad Rezaul Karim helped build early Bell Labs cellular networks and ATM systems, and Donald Dietmeyer advanced hardware description languages for IC design automation.
bullets: Frank Kuo co-developed ALOHAnet in 1971, creating the first public wireless packet data network and pioneering random-access protocols that influenced Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and mobile networks.
Kuo contributed to the expansion of China's internet infrastructure in the 1980s and 1990s, helping connect major academic institutions and co-developing CERNET.
Muhammad Rezaul Karim joined Bell Labs in 1972 and helped develop the control logic, transmitters, and receivers used in the pioneering 1978 Advanced Mobile Phone Service trial in Chicago.
Karim later worked on asynchronous transfer mode (ATM) networking technology to facilitate the transition from traditional telephony to broadband digital networks.
Donald Dietmeyer spent 40 years at the University of Wisconsin-Madison researching computer-aided design, switching theory, and hardware description languages for integrated circuits.
Dietmeyer and a former student pioneered the use of digital system design languages and contributed to the ConLan language-construction framework.

items.title: Norda 055 Trail Shoe Review
items.subtitle: Performance review of the plateless $325 Norda 055 trail super shoe
items.original_title: Norda 055 Review: The Plateless Trail Super Shoe That Performs Under Pressure
items.summary: The Norda 055 is a lightweight, plateless trail super shoe featuring a TPEE midsole, Bio-Dyneema upper, and Vibram Megagrip Elite outsole. It delivers exceptional stability on technical terrain and rapid drainage, though it commands a $325 price tag and runs short in sizing.
bullets: Weighs under 8 ounces with a low stack height and a poppy TPEE (Arnitel) midsole without a carbon plate.
Utilizes a single-piece Bio-Dyneema upper that is durable, highly breathable, and eliminates stitched overlays to prevent pressure points.
Features Vibram Megagrip Elite outsoles which provide exceptional grip and stability on technical, rocky terrain while remaining lightweight.
Includes a built-in taller cuff to block debris, replacing the need for separate running gaiters.
Sizing runs short; buyers must order a half-size up to prevent toe jamming on descents.
Retails for $325, positioning it among the most expensive high-end endurance trail options on the market.

items.title: 3rd FIDE Chess Olympiad for People with Disabilities Opens in Samarkand
items.subtitle: Record 41 teams start the seven-round Swiss tournament in Samarkand.
items.original_title: 3rd FIDE Chess Olympiad for People with Disabilities opens in Samarkand
items.summary: The 3rd FIDE Chess Olympiad for People with Disabilities has officially opened in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, featuring a record 41 teams from 36 countries. For the first time, this event is held concurrently with the main FIDE Chess Olympiad in the same host city. Play begins with a seven-round Swiss team format starting September 11.
bullets: A record 41 teams and around 200 players are participating in the 3rd edition.
For the first time, the tournament is held alongside the main FIDE Chess Olympiad in the same host city.
Teams must include players with hearing impairments, physical disabilities, and visual impairments, with at least one player of each gender per round.
The competition is structured as a seven-round Swiss team event, running from September 11 to September 17.
Top-seeded Poland drew the White pieces on the first board for Round 1.

bullets: The system uses Comau's MyCo collaborative robot integrated with a ROS 2-based software architecture.
Employs advanced sensors, vision-based object recognition, digital twin capabilities, and workflow orchestration tools.
Engineered to manipulate objects of varying shapes, weights, and materials, including rigid, soft, and porous items.
Developed as part of the MASTERLY initiative to transition toward flexible, customized manufacturing and logistics systems.
Integrated with contributions from partners including Decathlon and STAM.

items.title: Hoka Tecton X 4 Review
items.subtitle: Performance review and technical breakdown of the Hoka Tecton X 4 trail running shoe.
items.original_title: The Hoka Tecton X 4 Review: They’re Fast, Light, and Ready for Rocky Trails
items.summary: The Hoka Tecton X 4 is a carbon-plated trail racing shoe designed to balance propulsive speed with technical stability. Testing across sand, steep climbs, and rocky ridgelines highlights updates including a breathable Matryx Micro upper, retuned dual-layer PEBA foam, a repositioned carbon plate, and improved lateral stability.

Features a tough, breathable Matryx Micro woven upper that dries quickly and drains water efficiently.
Utilizes a ghillie lacing system over an integrated tongue and gaiter sleeve to eliminate heel lift and evenly distribute pressure.
Weighs nine grams less than the previous version and reduces side-to-side rigidity for a more planted feel on technical terrain.
Drawbacks include a very tight step-in opening with only a front pull tab, a tapered forefoot, and a high price point of $275.

items.title: How Full-Stack NIM Optimizations Deliver 2.5x More Users on Nemotron 3 Ultra
items.subtitle: How NVIDIA NIM 2.0.12 serving optimizations achieve 2.5x higher throughput on B200 GPUs.
items.original_title: How Full-Stack NIM Optimizations Deliver 2.5x More Users on Nemotron 3 Ultra
items.summary: NVIDIA's NIM 2.0.12 serving stack packages validated model- and GPU-aware optimizations for the Nemotron 3 Ultra model. Tested on a 4xB200 hardware setup running agentic workloads, the fully optimized stack achieves a 2.5x throughput increase compared to an unoptimized baseline by combining custom autotuned kernels, prefix caching, speculative decoding, and memory tuning.
bullets: Achieves 1,997 tokens/sec throughput compared to the baseline 718 tokens/sec on a 4xB200 system for agentic workloads with 64K context and 76% KV reuse.
Combines autotuned Mixture-of-Experts and Mamba kernels mapped specifically to NVIDIA Blackwell architecture.
Implements prefix caching and partial-prefix matching to avoid recomputing repeated context across agentic workflow steps.
Uses Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding to increase output rates while maintaining per-user latency targets.
Bundles tensor parallelism across four GPUs and expert-aware execution to maximize hardware utilization.

items.title: Skild AI S1 Foundation Model
items.subtitle: Learn how Skild AI's S1 model enables robots to execute tasks from a single video.
items.original_title: Skild AI Taps NVIDIA Physical AI to Teach Robots New Tasks From a Single Video
items.summary: Skild AI's new S1 robot foundation model uses in-context learning to execute unseen, long-horizon tasks from a single video demonstration without updating model weights or requiring task-specific retraining. The system runs on NVIDIA AI infrastructure, utilizing simulation frameworks like Isaac Sim and Isaac Lab to bridge the sim-to-real gap, and has already seen deployment in high-precision manufacturing environments.
bullets: The S1 model uses video input to interpret intent, objects, and sequences, mapping them directly into actions via in-context learning without updating weights.
It handles unfamiliar tasks lasting up to 10 minutes across dozens of manipulation steps, such as plant potting and kit assembly.
In tests on multistep tasks, S1 achieved a 66% step success rate compared to 9% for a baseline AI system.
A single video example replaces roughly 380 hands-on training examples, saving up to 100 hours of manual data collection.
Skild and Foxconn are deploying the Skild Brain on dual-arm manipulators to assemble NVIDIA Blackwell systems, handling precise insertion and screw fastening.

FIDE will use Agentforce 360 to run operations, unifying 204 national member federations and 1.5 million rated players onto a single platform.
A Chess Concierge Agent will answer queries on ratings, rules, and live tournament status for 1.2 million monthly visitors.

items.title: NVIDIA's End-to-End Robotaxi and Autonomous Vehicle Compute Architecture
items.subtitle: Learn how NVIDIA's three-tier stack powers global robotaxi development and deployment.
items.original_title: Physical AI Takes the Wheel: How the World’s Robotaxi Leaders Are Building With NVIDIA Technologies
items.summary: NVIDIA provides an end-to-end platform for robotaxi development, structured around a three-computer solution: DGX systems for model training, RTX PRO servers running Omniverse and Cosmos for simulation, and DRIVE Hyperion with DRIVE AGX Thor for in-vehicle computing. Major mobility providers and automakers—including Uber, Waymo, Zoox, and Mercedes-Benz—are leveraging this hardware and software ecosystem to scale level-4 autonomous fleets globally.
bullets: The NVIDIA robotaxi platform is divided into three core computing environments: training (DGX), simulation (Omniverse and Cosmos on RTX PRO), and in-vehicle (DRIVE Hyperion and DRIVE AGX Thor).
Integrating meta-action and chain-of-thought reasoning data into VLA models reduced minimum average displacement error by 43% from 2.08 to 1.18 in evaluations.
NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec and Cosmos world foundation models allow developers to turn real-world corner cases into millions of synthetic driving scenarios.
DRIVE Hyperion 10 utilizes dual DRIVE AGX Thor systems-on-a-chip built on the Blackwell architecture alongside 14 cameras, 9 radars, 3 lidars, and 12 ultrasonics for redundant sensor fusion.
Global fleets across Asia, Europe, and North America—such as Uber, May Mobility, WeRide, and Pony.ai—utilize components of the NVIDIA AV stack for commercial deployment.

items.summary: César de la Fuente's lab applies deep-learning models, Codex, and ChatGPT to search genomic and protein databases for new antimicrobial molecules. By treating biology as an information system, the team reduces candidate identification from years to hours while bridging gaps across scientific disciplines.
bullets: Treats DNA nucleotides and protein amino acids as an alphabet to decipher functional molecules using deep-learning models.
Reduces the initial candidate discovery phase from years to hours by scanning vast genomic and protein datasets.
Uses ChatGPT and Codex to write and refine code, process datasets, analyze results, and brainstorm hypotheses.
Employs AI to lower interdisciplinary barriers, allowing biologists to program and programmers to tackle biological problems.
Combines AI predictions with mandatory ground-truth laboratory experiments to validate antimicrobial efficacy and human cell safety.

items.title: High-Throughput Structure Prediction with BioNeMo Inference Runtime
items.subtitle: Learn how to scale biomolecular structure prediction pipelines using NVIDIA BioIR and Ray.
items.original_title: High-Throughput Structure Prediction with BioNeMo Inference Runtime
items.summary: NVIDIA's BioNeMo Inference Runtime (BioIR) accelerates biomolecular structure-prediction models like Boltz-2 and OpenFold using optimized kernels, CUDA Graphs, and Ray-based pipeline scaling. In a matched benchmark of 1,000 human dimer targets on 8xH100 GPUs, BioIR delivered a 2.90x improvement in residue-normalized throughput over a torch-compiled open-source implementation. The system separates per-replica model-forward optimizations from end-to-end CPU preprocessing stages to maximize hardware utilization at proteome scale.
bullets: BioIR supports two integration methods: an end-to-end processor handling parsing through writing, and direct PyTorch integration for custom modules.
The Ray backend runs full model replicas across multiple GPUs on a single node, scaling independent inputs concurrently while overlapping CPU stages.
Optimization operates at three distinct layers: kernel selection, module optimization via CUDA Graphs, and Ray-based pipeline scaling.
In 8xH100 benchmarks using Boltz-2, BioIR achieved 58.5K successfully folded residues per GPU-hour compared to 20.2K for the public baseline, which suffered 29 out-of-memory errors.
Linear extrapolation to one million targets estimates BioIR reduces folding energy consumption from 35 MWh down to 11 MWh based on 8-GPU TDP equivalents.

Integrates with communication tools like Slack and email to share findings and execute approved operational actions.

items.title: Vehicle Simulation and Modeling
items.subtitle: Learn how vehicle modeling and simulation replace early hardware prototypes.
items.original_title: Coursera Course Overview: Vehicle Simulation
items.summary: Vehicle modeling uses mathematical representations of electrical, mechanical, and thermal systems to predict performance before building physical prototypes. Longitudinal models calculate torque, speed, and range, while full vehicle models simulate six degrees of freedom for safety and comfort analysis using tools like MathWorks' Virtual Vehicle Composer.
bullets: Vehicle modeling simulates interconnected electrical, mechanical, and thermal systems to answer architecture and performance questions early.
Longitudinal vehicle models compute required drive torque, predict acceleration and range, and visualize component energy flows.
Full vehicle models incorporate six degrees of freedom (X, Y, Z, pitch, yaw, roll) to evaluate ride comfort and safety.
The MathWorks Virtual Vehicle Composer app provides predefined templates to build, customize, and test complete vehicle variants.
Virtual vehicle models enable rigorous testing of autonomous driving features, traction control, and real-time driver-in-the-loop simulations.

items.original_title: Come vincere contro la difesa est Indiana

Vengono esaminati i concetti di zone d'influenza, la rottura E4-F5 e le idee di gioco posizionale tratte da storiche partite magistrali.

Il bianco deve imporre il proprio vantaggio di spazio sul lato di donna, aprendo colonne tramite la spinta dei pedoni A e C.

La strategia sulle case chiare prevede il controllo della casa E4 e, in contesti specifici, la rottura attiva E5-F5 seguita da G4.

items.title: Powering AI is an architecture problem
items.subtitle: Why AI load swings crash grids and how medium-voltage inline UPS architectures fix it.
items.original_title: Powering AI is an architecture problem
items.summary: AI data centers create severe grid instability not through a lack of raw power generation, but because legacy 480-volt power stacks cannot handle rapid load swings and protection logic trips incorrectly during voltage dips. Moving power conditioning to a medium-voltage, inline architecture located outside the data hall flattens load profiles and insulates both the grid and compute hardware from transient events.
bullets: AI campuses can swing 70% of their load in milliseconds during training runs and trip offline instantly during upstream anomalies.
Legacy UPS units spend most of their time in bypass mode to save power, leaving compute exposed to raw transients and dumping unconditioned load swings back onto the grid.
Traditional protection logic relies on rules built for 50-megawatt loads, causing facilities to disconnect prematurely during routine grid voltage dips.

Proposed architectural fixes include moving power handling up to medium voltage (13.8kV), moving equipment outside near substations, and keeping systems inline permanently rather than relying on static bypass switches.
Testing at the National Laboratory of the Rockies demonstrated that a medium-voltage inline system successfully absorbed severe AI load swings and a zero-voltage grid fault without dropping compute.

items.title: Perdendo di vista ciò che è davvero importante, anche a sinistra
items.subtitle: Come il giustizialismo digitale e la ricerca di idoli sostituiscono la politica e i movimenti.
items.original_title: Perdendo di vista ciò che è davvero importante, anche a sinistra.
items.summary: L'analisi critica esamina la deriva giustizialista e l'ossessione per i social media che affligge anche la sinistra politica. Sostituendo i progetti collettivi e l'impegno reale con la ricerca di idoli e la gogna mediatica, si finisce per replicare le logiche populiste e di destra.
bullets: Il giustizialismo contemporaneo si manifesta sia nell'esaltazione di giustizieri fuori legge sia nel desiderio di giustiziare il prossimo tramite i social network.
La concentrazione esclusiva della sinistra sull'antiberlusconismo ha impedito di affrontare i nodi strutturali profondi, facendo scambiare l'effetto per la causa.
I social media abituano a una rappresentazione spettacolare delle passioni (stile wrestling) che oscura l'effettiva esistenza di movimenti politici reali sul territorio.
L'eccessiva attenzione mediatica verso intellettuali e cantautori rischia di trasformarli in idoli fragili, distogliendo l'energia dall'etica dell'impegno e della partecipazione concreta.

Implementata una tecnica di intelligenza artificiale per l'analisi in tempo reale di brevi videoclip ecografici.
Superato il limite delle precedenti rilevazioni spaziali basate su singole immagini non pulsatili.
La tecnologia è orientata a garantire maggiore autonomia medica nelle future missioni di lunga durata.
I ricercatori prevedono di validare il sistema su campioni più ampi e di studiarne possibili ricadute per la medicina terrestre.

items.title: GitHub Availability Report: August 2026
items.subtitle: Analysis of August 2026 outages, infrastructure scale, and Azure migration metrics.
items.original_title: GitHub availability report: August 2026
items.summary: GitHub reports on five major availability incidents in August 2026, driven by infrastructure saturation, database limits, and service-mesh sidecar failures. The company details its ongoing migration to Azure, architectural improvements, and remediation plans for Actions and Copilot services.
bullets: August 6 incident: A routine deployment reduced actions pod capacity, saturating service mesh sidecars, causing OOM restarts, and triggering a latent bug that caused runners to loop on revoked jobs.
August 17 incident: Traffic spikes exhausted load-balancer network flow limits and unscaled service-mesh sidecars, causing widespread authentication latency and amplifying client retry loops.
August 20 incident: A regional cloud database outage delayed Copilot cloud agent task-status streaming because fixed processing partitions were overwhelmed and failover configuration was slow.
August 26 incident: Traffic bursts and high load saturated a shared database primary, causing internal event-to-runner assignment services to stall before manual and automated throttling took effect.
August 27 incident: An upstream provider degradation caused 63.3% of GitHub Copilot requests using the Kimi K3 model to fail, while requests using other models remained unaffected.

Infrastructure progress: GitHub successfully ran MySQL primary databases from Azure, moved the authentication-core cohort off legacy databases to remove 1M queries/second, and improved load-shedding and monitoring systems.

items.title: Rebuilding AUTOMATIC1111 with Gradio Workflow
items.subtitle: Learn how Workflow1111 ports AUTOMATIC1111 features into a graph of 73 operators using Gradio.
items.original_title: Rebuilding AUTOMATIC1111 with Gradio Workflow
items.summary: Workflow1111 rebuilds AUTOMATIC1111's core feature set inside a single Gradio Workflow canvas using 73 nodes and 11 media pipelines. The system combines text-to-image, ControlNet-style annotators, upscaling, LLM prompt engineering, and video generation without requiring a local GPU. Furthermore, every output node automatically exposes a typed REST endpoint and can act as an MCP tool for AI assistants.
bullets: Workflow1111 is composed of 73 nodes across 11 media pipelines handling text-to-image, hi-res fix, image-to-image, VLM interrogation, detection-to-inpaint, and video generation.
The architecture utilizes four operator types: Python functions (fn), models called via InferenceClient, external Gradio Spaces, and dataset rows.
Over two-thirds of the nodes are local Python functions running entirely in-process using NumPy and Pillow, allowing offline execution for preprocessors and annotators.
Running models remotely via Inference Providers or spaces allows workflows to execute without dedicated local GPU hardware, though local checkpoints can also be bound directly.
Every output node on the canvas automatically becomes a REST endpoint via gradio_client and can be exposed as an MCP tool by setting mcp_server=True.

items.title: Come costruire un mini-pianeta in casa: la guida tecnica al Terrarium

items.original_title: Ho costruito un mini-pianeta a casa - come fare un Terrarium e perché
items.summary: Analisi passo-passo della costruzione di un terrario chiuso, un ecosistema autosufficiente che sfrutta i principi fisici e biologici del nostro pianeta. Il sistema dimostra in scala ridotta i meccanismi di circolarità della materia, dal ciclo dell'acqua alla fotosintesi e decomposizione.
bullets: Strato di drenaggio in argilla espansa sul fondo per evitare il ristagno d'acqua e il marciume radicale.
Carbone vegetale attivo per assorbire tossine, gas nocivi e cattivi odori derivanti dalla decomposizione.
Perlite e sabbia per stabilizzare il pH, regolare la temperatura e impedire la formazione di ambienti anossici.
Ciclo idrologico chiuso: l'acqua evapora dal terreno con il calore, condensa sul vetro freddo e ripiomba come pioggia.
Equilibrio dinamico tra fotosistesi di giorno (produzione di ossigeno e glucosio) e respirazione di notte.

items.title: Perché ci ossessioniamo di una persona
items.subtitle: I cinque meccanismi psicologici dietro l'ossessione relazionale
items.original_title: Perché sono ossessionato da una persona
items.summary: L'ossessione per un'altra persona non è solo un capriccio mentale, ma il risultato di dinamiche neurochimiche e psicologiche profonde. Lo psicoterapeuta Michele Mezzanotto analizza i cinque fattori scatenanti: dalle dinamiche tossiche basate sulla dopamina al rinforzo intermittente, dalla coazione a ripetere di traumi infantili all'idealizzazione e agli stili di attaccamento ansioso.
bullets: Dinamica tossica: le relazioni disfunzionali attivano circuiti simili alla tossicodipendenza, rilasciando dopamina e abbassando la serotonina per coprire vuoti interiori.
Rinforzo intermittente: l'alternanza imprevedibile tra presenza e assenza dell'altro genera una dipendenza psicologica difficile da interrompere.
Coazione a ripetere: la psiche riproduce vecchi traumi relazionali non risolti attraverso nuove persone per costringerci a guarire la ferita originaria.
Idealizzazione: si proiettano sull'altro aspettative e caratteristiche desiderate ma inespresse del proprio mondo interiore.
Attaccamento ansioso: la tendenza a cercare relazioni impossibili o a distanza riflette una comfort zone emotiva basata su modelli relazionali insicuri.

items.title: La promessa di Trump sui 5.000 dollari, i tassi BCE e i documenti su Ceuta
items.subtitle: Analisi della fattibilità del bonus elettorale di Trump, delle mosse BCE e dei documenti su Ceuta
items.original_title: Trump promette 5.000 dollari a ogni americano SE VINCE le midterm 2026 | The Essential
items.summary: Analisi approfondita della proposta di Donald Trump di erogare 5.000 dollari a ogni cittadino americano in vista delle elezioni di midterm, valutandone la copertura e l'impatto sull'inflazione. Vengono inoltre esaminati l'aumento dei tassi della BCE dovuto alla crisi energetica, la proroga dello sconto sul gasolio in Italia e i documenti dell'intelligence spagnola sulla crisi migratoria di Ceuta.
bullets: Donald Trump ha promesso un bonus di 5.000 dollari a ogni cittadino statunitense se i repubblicani vinceranno le elezioni di midterm 2026, una misura da circa mille miliardi di dollari senza una chiara copertura finanziaria.
Il vicepresidente J.D. Vance ha ipotizzato di finanziare parzialmente il bonus tramite i proventi dei dazi doganali o di modularlo in base alle fasce di reddito.

Gli economisti avvertono che l'iniezione di liquidità rischierebbe di alimentare ulteriormente l'inflazione e di impattare negativamente sul debito pubblico in un'economia statunitense caratterizzata da una disoccupazione molto bassa.

La BCE ha deciso di alzare nuovamente i tassi di interesse per contrastare un'inflazione che non tornerà al target del 2% prima del 2028, spinta soprattutto dalla crisi energetica legata al conflitto in Medio Oriente.

Nuovi documenti dell'intelligence spagnola rivelano che i servizi segreti avevano avvisato il governo di Madrid e quello marocchino il 29 luglio, il giorno prima dell'assalto di massa di 80.000 migranti alla barriera di Ceuta.

items.title: Async GRPO with LoRA across HF Jobs
items.subtitle: How to run asynchronous GRPO training and vLLM inference on separate machines using LoRA.
items.original_title: Async GRPO with LoRA across HF Jobs: a bucket, a proxy, and no NCCL
items.summary: This article details an asynchronous GRPO training setup that pairs TRL's AsyncGRPOTrainer with vLLM on separate Hugging Face Jobs. By training rank-1 LoRA adapters and syncing them via a shared Storage Bucket instead of NCCL, the system avoids heavy network requirements. A custom proxy routes generation requests to maximize KV cache hits and broadcasts adapter updates to ensure version consistency.
bullets: Rank-1 LoRA adapters for a 1.5B model require only a few megabytes, allowing state synchronization via a mounted FUSE storage bucket instead of NCCL across separate virtual machines.
A custom proxy inspects incoming token blocks, hashing them to route requests to the vLLM replica already holding the KV prefix in cache while ignoring common prefixes like chat templates.
Versioned adapter naming prevents KV cache mismatch errors by ensuring cached prefixes never match newer policy weights.
Token-budget batching packs multiple sequences densely into each row to improve GPU utilization and resolve training bottlenecks.
A max_staleness parameter determines the number of active adapter slots needed in vLLM to service older rollouts in flight without eviction.

items.title: What bricklaying has taught Monumental about robots in construction

items.original_title: What bricklaying has taught Monumental about robots in construction
items.summary: Monumental is deploying a fleet of three specialized robots to automate bricklaying and material handling on construction sites. By operating as a standard subcontractor rather than forcing deep enterprise software integration, the company navigates the fragmented construction industry while gathering critical real-world edge-case data.
bullets: Monumental's robot fleet consists of Pisa (the pick-and-place bricklaying robot with dual arms), Petra (delivers bricks), and Panama (supplies mortar).
Only 10% of Monumental's software is specific to bricklaying, while the remaining 90% is general-purpose robotics infrastructure for construction sites.
The company uses a mushroom-shaped device called Pathion to provide local 4G, 5G, Starlink computes, and Wi-Fi to the robots on site.
Monumental operates as a standard subcontractor, allowing it to integrate into the fragmented construction ecosystem without altering enterprise software workflows.
Early field deployments exposed unexpected edge cases, such as failing to recognize pitch-black bricks due to computer vision models trained primarily on red bricks.

items.title: Encode-Prefill-Decode Disaggregation for Multimodal Models
items.subtitle: Learn when to decouple vision encoders from LLM workers using NVIDIA Dynamo.
items.original_title: When to Use Encode-Prefill-Decode Disaggregation to Accelerate Multimodal Model Serving
items.summary: Encode-prefill-decode (EPD) disaggregation splits vision encoder workloads from LLM prefill and decode phases to improve multimodal serving performance. Using NVIDIA Dynamo, this approach can accelerate time to first token by up to 5x and increase goodput under media-heavy workloads by isolating resource contention. EPD is most effective for short-to-medium output lengths, quantized mixture-of-experts models, and mixed traffic profiles.
bullets: Separates vision transformer (ViT) encoding from LLM prefill and decode to prevent media preprocessing from delaying text-only requests or concurrent execution.
Colocated encoder topology runs encoder workers alongside prefill-decode (PD) workers on homogeneous GPUs, separating queues without underutilizing hardware.
Dislocated encoder topology uses a separate, lower-cost GPU tier (e.g., RTX 6000D) for vision encoding while passing embeddings via NIXL to primary high-end GPUs (e.g., GB200).
Delivers significant TTFT and goodput gains for input media-heavy requests, small or quantized models (like NVFP4), and mixed text-multimodal traffic.
Becomes less effective as output sequence length (OSL) increases, because decode time eventually dominates end-to-end latency.
Additional Dynamo levers include parallel media decoding, embedding caching in CPU DRAM, and multimodal KV routing to further cut latency.

items.title: CUDA Toolkit 13.4 Adds Windows on Arm Support and Greater Control over Shared GPUs
items.subtitle: CUDA 13.4 adds Rubin preview, MPS V3 resource controls, and CCCL 3.4 parallel algorithms.
items.original_title: CUDA Toolkit 13.4 Adds Windows on Arm Support and Greater Control over Shared GPUs
items.summary: NVIDIA CUDA Toolkit 13.4 introduces Windows on Arm support, developer preview for the Rubin GPU architecture, and Multi-Process Service V3 for scriptable GPU partitioning. The release also updates CUDA Python, ships CCCL 3.4 with single-call CUB APIs and C++ standard library parallel algorithms, and expands Nsight developer tools.
bullets: Adds functional support for the NVIDIA Rubin architecture (compute capability 107) as a developer preview.
Introduces Multi-Process Service (MPS) V3 with a scriptable CLI, TOML configuration, SM partition controls, and cgroup-integrated memory limits.
Exposes CUDA Compute Fabric Transport (CFT) via the Driver API to execute asynchronous NVLink transfers using named logical endpoints.
Ships CCCL 3.4 featuring a warp-specialized cub::DeviceScan on Blackwell achieving up to 92% memory-bandwidth utilization, single-call CUB APIs, and cuda::std parallel algorithms.
Updates cuBLASLt on Blackwell to dynamically schedule Grouped GEMM computations for MoE workloads and adds new FP8 scaling modes.

bullets: Unitree closed at 513.93 yuan ($72.10) on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, down about 53% from its first-day high of 1,100 yuan.
The company raised 6.1 billion yuan ($900 million) in its IPO, surging 460% on its debut day.

U.S. peer Agility Robotics reported $1.78 million in net sales for 2025 with a $138.1 million net loss, contrasting with Unitree's commercial scale.

items.title: Conner Mantz's Training, Routine, and Recovery
items.subtitle: How America's fastest marathoner trains, handles sacral stress fractures, and builds consistency.
items.original_title: Conner Mantz Went from Breaking the 23-Year-Old American Marathon Record to a Devastating Injury. Now He’s Building Back Up.
items.summary: American record-holding marathoner Conner Mantz breaks down his training regimen, coaching philosophy under Ed Eyestone, and recovery from a severe sacral stress fracture. The article examines the intersection of high-mileage elite endurance training, strict routine, and the mental discipline required to chase global podium spots.
bullets: Mantz set the American marathon record with a time of 2:04:43 at the Chicago Marathon, finishing fourth overall.
He suffered a major sacral stress fracture that sidelined him for 12 weeks after returning to intense training too quickly following Chicago.
His weekly training volume ranges from 100 to 130 miles, typically divided into double days on Tuesdays and Thursdays with strength work.
Trains under legendary coach Ed Eyestone at BYU, utilizing a philosophy centered on consistent competence leading to eventual excellence (C2 = E2).
His daily nutrition strategy involves snacking every two waking hours, using Maurten fuel bars, and high-protein adjustments like cottage cheese and eggs.

items.title: Venezia83 – The Pervert’s Guide to Utopias: la critica di Žižek alla speranza
items.subtitle: Slavoj Žižek spiega nel nuovo film perché la speranza paralizza l'azione e invoca il pessimismo.
items.original_title: Venezia83 – The Pervert’s Guide to Utopias: Žižek non può proprio perdonare Dio
items.summary: In occasione della prima mondiale di The Pervert’s Guide to Utopias, Slavoj Žižek e la regista Sophie Fiennes argomentano che la speranza non è una spinta al cambiamento ma un meccanismo di paralisi ideologica. L'attesa di un intervento salvifico, che sia la Storia, la politica o Dio, impedisce di affrontare la realtà della catastrofe imminente e di agire concretamente.
bullets: Slavoj Žižek prevede lo scoppio della Terza guerra mondiale nei prossimi cinquant'anni.
Il pessimismo radicale viene presentato come l'unica condizione in grado di spingere gli individui all'azione.
La speranza viene definita un servo ideologico che fa credere che qualcuno o qualcosa interverrà a salvarci.
Il film The Pervert’s Guide to Utopias esplora il sospetto che non sia la disperazione a bloccare gli uomini, bensì la speranza stessa.
L'apocalisse non va intesa in senso metaforico, poiché la fine del mondo può essere reale e definitiva.

items.title: Elite Trail Runner Kalie McCrystal Missing on the Matterhorn
items.subtitle: Details of the search operation and training background for the missing FKT athlete.
items.original_title: An Elite Trail Runner Vanished During a Training Run on the Matterhorn. 8 Days Later, She’s Still Missing.
items.summary: Elite Canadian trail runner and mountaineer Kalie McCrystal disappeared on September 1 while attempting a training run on the Matterhorn's Lion’s Ridge route. Despite extensive aerial and ground rescue efforts utilizing helicopters and RECCO technology across the steep alpine terrain, search operations have been suspended while investigators examine cellular and device data.
bullets: McCrystal disappeared while training to break the fastest known time (FKT) for climbing and descending the Matterhorn via the Lion’s Ridge route in under five hours.
She previously set an FKT on the Hornli Ridge route in August, completing the return trip from Zermatt in 6 hours, 47 minutes, and 33 seconds.
She was last confirmed seen on the afternoon of September 1 near Pic Tyndall at over 13,800 feet by a group of Polish climbers and a rescue telescope observer.
Search efforts by Italian and Swiss teams included aerial sweeps with RECCO technology and ground searches, though operations were later paused due to the extreme danger and steepness of the terrain.
Investigators are currently analyzing data from a second SIM card and digital devices to narrow down her last known location on the mountain.

items.title: NVIDIA Expands AI for Media and Holoscan Architecture at IBC
items.subtitle: NVIDIA launches real-time video AI SDKs, microservices, and media exchange layers.
items.original_title: NVIDIA Brings Real-Time AI to Broadcast, Sports and Global Streaming at IBC
items.summary: NVIDIA announced major expansions to its AI for Media and Holoscan for Media platforms at IBC 2026. The updates introduce GPU-accelerated SDKs, NIM microservices, and open reference architectures for real-time video verification, body pose estimation, frame generation, localization, and sports analytics.
bullets: Synthetic Video Detector (SVD) NIM microservice achieved 99.3% accuracy for text-to-video and 97.7% for image-to-video content, integrated by Dalet, TwelveLabs, and Wowza.
3D Body Pose estimates 2D and 3D joint locations from a single camera to drive real-time virtual lighting and motion tracking.
Video Frame Generation (VFG) uses generative AI to interpolate intermediate frames, enabling 2x to 6x slow-motion generation for live sports replay.
LipSync and Active Speaker Detection NIM microservices enable real-time translated dubbing while preserving natural head pose and facial textures.
Holoscan for Media integrates the Media Exchange Layer (MXL) to provide an open architecture for distributed, software-defined live production applications.
Sports Intelligence Playbooks provide frameworks to fine-tune open models like Nemotron on proprietary footage, raising multi-choice evaluation accuracy from 53% to 94%.

items.title: IBM Releases Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2
items.subtitle: IBM's 385M-parameter zero-shot time series model uses conformer layers.
items.original_title: IBM releases SOTA Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2 model with commercial-friendly license
items.summary: IBM has released Granite Time Series PatchTST-FM-r2, a 385-parameter zero-shot forecasting model featuring a conformer-based architecture. The model is dual-licensed under Apache 2.0 and OpenMDW 1.0, achieving top-tier performance on the GIFT-Eval benchmark among permissively licensed models.
bullets: Model size is approximately 385M parameters, supporting context lengths up to 8,192 steps and probabilistic forecasts via a 99-quantile prediction head.

Replaces standard transformer layers with conformer blocks that combine multi-head self-attention with temporal convolution (kernel sizes 3 and 5) to capture both long- and short-range temporal structures.
Utilizes 50% overlapping patches with Hamming-window weighting and overlap-and-add forecasting to smooth patch boundaries.
Ranks second overall among replicable zero-shot models on the GIFT-Eval benchmark (geometric-mean CRPS of 0.467, MASE of 0.6846) and first among permissively licensed models.
Pretraining data corpus consists of GiftEvalPretrain subsets, KernelSynth synthetic data, TSMixup, and 500,000 synthetic CauKer sequences.
Available open-source via Hugging Face and integrated into the granite-tsfm Python library for zero-shot forecasting without fine-tuning.

items.title: An Engineer’s Guide to Surviving a Layoff
items.subtitle: Practical tactics for managing a job loss and preserving engineering expertise.
items.original_title: An Engineer’s Guide to Surviving a Layoff
items.summary: This article provides a tactical framework for navigating an engineering layoff, emphasizing financial auditing, alternative networking channels, and structured interview preparation. It also highlights the risk of losing human expertise as automation and AI take over foundational tasks.
bullets: Take a few days to decompress before job hunting to avoid accepting misaligned roles out of desperation.
Audit recurring expenses and subscriptions immediately to extend personal runway and reduce financial stress.
Expand networking beyond LinkedIn by leveraging former colleagues, adjacent vendors, and startup-specific boards.
Catalog specific project wins and leadership examples early to rebuild confidence and prepare for future interviews.
Maintain manual operational steps in automated systems to prevent the erosion of human expertise.

items.title: OpenAI's Policy Framework for Frontier AI Safety and Regulation
items.subtitle: OpenAI details its positions on mandatory federal AI safety regulations and state bills.
items.original_title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
items.summary: OpenAI outlines its strategy for AI governance, calling for mandatory national capability-based safety requirements, standardized third-party audits, and strict incident reporting. The company endorses specific California bills to establish interim baselines and emphasizes that safety metrics must pace capability advances to maintain public trust.
bullets: Supports mandatory federal capability-based safety requirements targeting well-resourced frontier labs.
Endorses four California bills covering independent safety assessments, AI-auditor standards, youth protections, and biological threat safeguards.
Advocates for 'reverse federalism' where state-level laws establish a de facto baseline that Congress can eventually codify.
Proposes universal monitoring of model trajectories, including chains of thought and mandatory alignment-evaluation gates before deployment.
Calls for mandatory disclosure rules when models bypass security controls or exhibit consequential misalignment incidents.

bullets: OpenAI used 10,000 AI agents over 88 hours to tackle the Navier-Stokes equations, spending millions in the process.
The US accused six Chinese AI firms—including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, Alibaba, and Z.AI—of stealing trade secrets via model distillation.

US battery installations reached a record 20.2 gigawatt-hours in Q2 2026, driven by cheaper hardware and rising grid storage demands.

items.title: Siamo vermi? Per Pierre Huyghe non è un insulto
items.subtitle: Come l'artista Pierre Huyghe usa il verme per decostruire l'identità umana e il museo.
items.original_title: Siamo vermi? Per Pierre Huyghe non è un insulto
items.summary: Nella mostra alla Fondation Beyeler, l'artista Pierre Huyghe utilizza un verme robotico e artificiale, intitolato Alchimia, per mettere in crisi l'idea di un soggetto umano compatto e autonomo. L'installazione trasforma lo spazio museale in un organismo distribuito, dove materia viva, macchine e architettura si contaminano a vicenda.
bullets: Alchimia (2026) è un verme artificiale in silicone e soft robotics che respira grazie a un sistema pneumatico collegato ad altre opere della mostra.
Huyghe sposta l'attenzione dall'oggetto singolo alle condizioni sistemiche che lo generano, fondendo materia viva, algoritmi e architettura in un unico ecosistema.
Il museo viene trattato come un organismo soggetto a muta: polvere, scavi delle pareti e tracce delle mostre precedenti migrano da una sala all'altra.
Il corpo umano perde la sua centralità e i suoi confini originari, venendo ridefinito come un mero confine adibito al transito e alle relazioni con l'esterno.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra: New Capabilities, Pricing, and Enterprise Controls
items.subtitle: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra brings native computer use, safety benchmarks, and new enterprise controls.
items.original_title: GPT-6 Astra: The next generation in intelligence for work
items.summary: OpenAI has introduced GPT-6 Astra, an aligned model designed for professional work, software engineering, and computer use across existing applications without requiring custom APIs. The model features state-of-the-art cost efficiency, advanced safety controls to limit unintended outcomes, and new enterprise deployment settings. Pricing starts at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.
bullets: Integrated computer use allows Astra to operate software applications and write code directly through existing interfaces without requiring dedicated APIs.
Internal engineering tests showed Astra resolved a memory-allocation bottleneck in Codex sessions, yielding 25x lower turn latency with roughly 30% higher peak memory use.
Cost efficiency pricing is set at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, designed to complete tasks in fewer tokens and retries.
Safety evaluations reported Astra produced unintended outcomes 89% less often than GPT-5.6 Sol and 74.7% less often than Claude Fable 5.1 on an internal computer use benchmark.
New enterprise admin controls enable restrictions on approved websites, desktop applications, file transfers, and require confirmation policies for consequential actions.

items.subtitle: Analisi del film horror e del tema morale del gioco "Preferiresti" applicato al cinema.

items.summary: Il film "L'estranea" di Strippoli utilizza il classico tema del patto col diavolo e del dilemma morale estremo per costruire un horror che unisce intrattenimento, critica sociale e toni grotteschi. items.summary: Il ministro Adolfo Urso guida la delegazione italiana all'International Space Summit di Parigi per discutere di sicurezza spaziale, space economy e competitività europea. items.title: Understanding the Thermal Ceiling in Portable Power
items.subtitle: How active cooling overcomes thermal throttling in portable chargers.
items.original_title: Understanding the thermal ceiling in portable power
items.summary: Portable chargers suffer from a specification gap where peak wattage ratings ignore thermal throttling caused by heat dissipation limits. Anker's MagGo Power Bank 2 Pro addresses this by integrating active thermal management, using a micro centrifugal fan and dual airflow channels to sustain high charging speeds.
bullets: Smartphones reduce charging current as temperature rises to prevent permanent battery chemical degradation.
Inductive magnetic wireless charging generates heat at both transmitting and receiving coils, causing passive dissipation methods to hit structural limits quickly.
Active cooling systems using micro centrifugal fans and dual airflow channels move heat faster than passive materials like graphite sheets.
The Anker MagGo Power Bank 2 Pro keeps surface temperatures below 96.8 °F (36 °C) during 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging.
Active cooling during input allows the power bank to accept 45 watts and reach 80% charge in 52 minutes.

items.title: I custodi dei cimiteri italiani raccontano la memoria
items.subtitle: Un reportage tra i custodi dei cimiteri italiani e i loro ruoli mutati nel tempo.
items.original_title: Chi si prende cura dei nostri cari quando non ci sono più?
items.summary: Un'indagine attraverso i racconti dei custodi dei cimiteri italiani, da Roma a Venezia, per analizzare come sono cambiati i riti funebri, la percezione della memoria e il ruolo di questi operatori. Il lavoro unisce mansioni di manutenzione, giardinaggio e accoglienza, fungendo da osservatorio sul rapporto della società con la morte e il tempo.
bullets: A Roma, il Cimitero Verano è gestito dall'azienda dei rifiuti AMA, evidenziando come la gestione amministrativa tratti i cimiteri come spazi di confine urbano.
Molte concessioni storiche al Verano decadono per mancanza di eredi che si facciano carico della manutenzione delle tombe.
Al cimitero ebraico di Venezia, il custode Artemio gestisce quattro ettari di verde e la fauna locale, combinando la cura botanica con la conservazione della memoria storica della diaspora.

I custodi intervistati provengono da percorsi lavorativi differenti, come ex spazzini, operai o insegnanti, e descrivono una progressiva diminuzione delle visite e dei frequentatori abituali rispetto al passato.

items.title: La storia geologica della Pianura Padana e le montagne sepolte
items.subtitle: Scopri come si è formata la Pianura Padana e quali montagne si celano nel suo sottosuolo
items.original_title: La storia geologica della Pianura Padana e cosa c'è sotto [spoiler: montagne]
items.summary: La Pianura Padana nasconde nel suo sottosuolo una complessa struttura geologica caratterizzata da catene montuose sepolte e faglie attive generate dalla compressione tra Alpi e Appennini. Questo paesaggio pianeggiante, un tempo occupato dal mare, è il risultato dell'accumulo di sedimenti fluviali in un bacino di avanpaese causato dal peso delle montagne circostanti. Le indagini geofisiche e i pozzi esplorativi petroliferi hanno permesso di svelare queste dinamiche crostali che continuano a provocare sismicità naturale.
bullets: Sotto la superficie pianeggiante della Pianura Padana giacciono strati di ghiaie, sabbie e argille spessi fino a migliaia di metri, depositati dai fiumi nell'ultimo milione di anni.

A profondità maggiori di 5-10 chilometri si trovano rocce piegate e faglie che costituiscono vere e proprie montagne sepolte, frutto di un sistema tettonico a doppio fronte spinto da Alpi e Appennini.

La conoscenza approfondita di queste strutture sotterranee deriva dai dati raccolti tramite sismica a riflessione e migliaia di chilometri di pozzi esplorativi perforati a partire dagli anni '50 e '60 per la ricerca di idrocarburi.
Tra i 5 e i 3 milioni di anni fa gran parte della Pianura Padana era un golfo marino dell'Adriatico, colmato progressivamente dai sedimenti trasportati dal fiume Po e dai suoi affluenti.

La struttura geologica sotterranea non è statica: l'anticlinale della Mirandola cresce di circa un millimetro all'anno e i movimenti delle faglie profonde sono la causa naturale dei terremoti nell'area, come quello del maggio 2012.

items.title: I risultati matematici dell'intelligenza artificiale non sono un male
items.subtitle: Perché i risultati dell'IA nella matematica avanzata arricchiscono la conoscenza e offrono nuove basi di studio.
items.original_title: I risultati matematici dell'AI non sono un male
items.summary: I recenti risultati dell'intelligenza artificiale in matematica, come la dimostrazione di singolarità nelle equazioni di fluidodinamica, vengono criticati da alcuni esperti per il presunto disincentivo alla ricerca umana. Tuttavia, la disponibilità di nuove prove formali (verificabili tramite strumenti come Lean) non distrugge il valore della matematica, ma fornisce dati inediti che possono essere analizzati, semplificati e utilizzati per sviluppare nuove tecniche.
bullets: OpenAI ha risolto una sfida di fluidodinamica dimostrando l'esistenza di singolarità in equazioni studiate da 200 anni.
La scoperta chiarisce i limiti pratici di simulazioni numeriche che in casi limite producono velocità infinite teoriche.
Le critiche di matematici come Terence Tao riflettono il timore di perdere uno status accademico protetto piuttosto che un limite della conoscenza.
Le prove ottenute dall'IA possono essere scomposte e studiate per derivare nuovi strumenti matematici e interpretazioni più profonde.

items.title: Vigilia di Champions League: l'analisi di Gasperini e Hermoso
items.subtitle: Gasperini e Hermoso presentano il debutto europeo della Roma contro il Fenerbahce.

items.summary: Gian Piero Gasperini e Mario Hermoso presentano in conferenza stampa la prima partita di Champions League della Roma contro il Fenerbahce. Il tecnico sottolinea l'importanza di mantenere le proprie caratteristiche e la mentalità propositiva, gestendo le rotazioni della rosa in vista dei prossimi impegni ravvicinati. Il difensore evidenzia la solidità ritrovata dalla squadra e la mentalità vincente trasmessa dal mister.
bullets: Gasperini chiede alla squadra di non snaturarsi e di giocare faccia a faccia contro i migliori club europei sfruttando le proprie caratteristiche.
Il tecnico conferma che, a causa del calendario fitto con nove partite in meno di un mese, il ricorso alle rotazioni e ai cambi sarà fondamentale.
Hermoso spiega che il miglioramento della fase difensiva rispetto al pre-campionato è legato al lavoro duro e all'assimilazione della mentalità richiesta dall'allenatore.
Analizzando gli avversari, Gasperini evidenzia che il Fenerbahce possiede una rosa ampia e di valore, nonostante le assenze di rilievo come Asensio e Yandas.

items.title: La crisi tedesca e lo scontro politico tra Merz, AfD e Washington
items.subtitle: Analisi della crisi industriale tedesca, l'avanzata di AfD e lo scontro diplomatico con Trump.
items.original_title: Scontro Merz-Trump!
items.summary: La Germania attraversa una fase di forte tensione politica ed economica, segnata dal duro scontro in Parlamento tra il cancelliere Merz e l'estrema destra di AfD. Le difficoltà economiche dei Land orientali, figlie di decenni di deindustrializzazione e privatizzazioni, alimentano il consenso per l'AfD, mentre si deteriorano anche i rapporti diplomatici con gli Stati Uniti guidati da Donald Trump.
bullets: Il cancelliere Merz ha annullato una telefonata istituzionale con la Casa Bianca in seguito ai commenti di Donald Trump a sostegno dell'AfD.
Il voto in Sassonia-Anhalt evidenzia l'avanzata dell'estrema destra, favorita dal malcontento economico e dal progressivo impoverimento dei Land orientali.
Le politiche di deindustrializzazione e le privatizzazioni selvagge avviate dagli anni '90 hanno eroso il tessuto produttivo e i salari dei lavoratori tedeschi.
La retorica dell'AfD punta sui temi identitari e anti-immigrazione ma manca di un reale programma di statalizzazione o protezione industriale.
La precarizzazione del lavoro e il calo dei salari vengono strumentalizzati attribuendo la colpa ai flussi migratori anziché alle dinamiche contrattuali.

items.title: I figli della scimmia: paternità, inconscio e regia analogica
items.subtitle: Come Tommaso Landucci e Riccardo Scamarcio hanno evitato i cliché nei drammi familiari.
items.original_title: Una sorpresa di Venezia 83? con Riccardo Scamarcio e Tommaso Landucci
items.summary: Il regista Tommaso Landucci e l'attore Riccardo Scamarcio analizzano il film I figli della scimmia, discutendo le scelte di scrittura e regia dietro un dramma familiare non convenzionale. L'approccio evita i cliché emotivi e il didascalismo, esplorando l'inconscio dei personaggi, il rapporto complesso tra l'essere padri e l'essere stati figli, e l'uso della pellicola analogica per imprimere sacralità e tensione sul set.
bullets: Il look rasato a zero del protagonista riflette una scelta inconscia di rinuncia alla vanità e un'impostazione quasi militare nell'affrontare le proprie responsabilità.
La sceneggiatura evita deliberatamente la compassione ricattatoria e la bidimensionalità dei personaggi, optando per un'educazione sentimentale imperfetta.
L'ispirazione visiva e di tono deriva dal cinema di Hirokazu Kore-eda, apprezzato per la capacità di trattare i drammi familiari con calore e senza suddividere i personaggi in buoni e cattivi.
La scelta di girare in pellicola analogica ha imposto limiti fisici al magazzino della cinepresa, aumentando la concentrazione della troupe e la sacralità della messa in scena.
Il titolo del film deriva vagamente da una favola di Esopo sulla preferenza di una scimmia verso i propri figli, mantenendo una funzione evocativa e non didascalica.

items.title: Dimissioni dall'IA, crisi degli affitti e tensioni petrolifere
items.subtitle: Rischi esistenziali dell'IA, criteri UE per gli affitti brevi e prezzi del petrolio sopra i 100 dollari.
items.original_title: Chi costruisce l’IA pensa che potrebbe UCCIDERCI, dice un ex ricercatore Anthropic | The Essential
items.summary: Un ex ricercatore di Anthropic si è dimesso denunciando i rischi esistenziali e la mancanza di sicurezza nello sviluppo dell'intelligenza artificiale. Parallelamente, l'Unione Europea lavora a nuove regole per limitare gli affitti brevi nelle zone in forte stress abitativo, mentre il petrolio torna a superare i 100 dollari al barile a causa del blocco nello stretto di Hormuz.
bullets: Il ricercatore Jacob Coxon ha lasciato Anthropic criticando la corsa sfrenata allo sviluppo dell'IA senza adeguate misure di sicurezza.
Molti esperti stimano una probabilità non trascurabile, almeno del 10%, che i sistemi di IA possano rappresentare un rischio esistenziale entro dieci anni.
L'Unione Europea sta elaborando l'Affordable Housing Act per facilitare restrizioni locali sugli affitti brevi basate sul rapporto tra prezzi immobiliari e reddito pro capite.
Il prezzo del petrolio ha superato i 100 dollari al barile per la prima volta da luglio a causa dei conflitti e dei blocchi navali nello stretto di Hormuz.
Immagini satellitari indicano che l'Iran sta proseguendo la costruzione di infrastrutture sotterranee protette per il nucleare a sud di Teheran.

items.title: Mourinho analizza la vittoria contro l'Inter e il prossimo ritorno a Roma

items.summary: Dopo il successo per 2-1 del Real Madrid contro l'Inter in Champions League, José Mourinho ha analizzato i dettagli tattici della sfida e l'andamento della partita. L'allenatore ha anche difeso la prestazione di Kylian Mbappé e ha presentato la prossima sfida contro la sua ex Roma.
bullets: Mourinho ha definito la gara contro l'Inter una partita pazza e spettacolare caratterizzata da innumerevoli occasioni da rete da entrambe le parti.
L'allenatore ha evidenziato che la sua squadra poteva chiudere la partita nel primo tempo ma ha rischiato di subire il pareggio fino agli ultimi minuti.
Mourinho ha difeso Kylian Mbappé dalle critiche del Bernabeu, scommettendo su di lui come futuro capocannoniere della Champions League.

items.title: Brooks Glycerin GTS 23 Review
items.subtitle: Comparing the neutral and stability variants of the DNA Tuned daily trainer.
items.original_title: Brooks Glycerin GTS 23 Adds Subtle Stability to Our Favorite Daily Trainer—Without Changing the Plush Ride

Testers noted that the transition to DNA Tuned foam provides a softer, more responsive experience compared to previous iterations, while the GuideRails system offers unobtrusive knee and ankle alignment support.
bullets: Features DNA Tuned foam midsole, utilizing larger cells in the heel and smaller cells in the forefoot for balanced softness and responsiveness.
Adds 2 mm of DNA Tuned foam in the forefoot compared to older versions, resulting in a slightly stiffer initial feel that softens over time.
The stability GTS version incorporates medial and lateral GuideRails foam bumpers to align the knees and feet during erratic movement or form fatigue.
The stability GTS model weighs only a tenth of an ounce more than the neutral Glycerin 23 (8.9 oz vs 8.8 oz for a women's size 6.5).
Engineered knit upper provides a secure midfoot and ankle fit alongside an accommodating, roomy toebox suitable for wider feet or runners prone to swelling.

items.title: Boston Dynamics veterans launch Dynamic Creatures for entertainment robotics
items.subtitle: Former Boston Dynamics executives launch Dynamic Creatures for entertainment robotics.

items.summary: Former Boston Dynamics executives Marc Theermann and Farbod Farshidian have launched Dynamic Creatures, an entertainment robotics company. The startup introduces the SnowJay AI and robotics platform, leveraging reinforcement learning, motion capture, and NVIDIA tools to power natural locomotion and human-robot interaction on third-party hardware like Spot and Atlas. They plan to deploy managed pilots using assisted autonomy and puppeteering starting in early 2027.
bullets: Co-founded by former Boston Dynamics CSO Marc Theermann and research leader Farbod Farshidian, with Boston Dynamics serving as an official partner.
SnowJay platform uses NVIDIA tools and reinforcement learning on top of motion capture or animations to achieve natural locomotion.
Initial deployments will use third-party hardware like Boston Dynamics' Spot and Atlas, and Unitree robots, with future plans to build proprietary humanoid hardware.
Early character prototypes include a purple poodle named Danielle and a Tyrolean mountain troll, built for theme parks, casinos, and hospitality environments.
Deployments in 2027 will rely on managed pilots combining teleoperation, puppeteering, and assisted autonomy to collect interaction data.
Company research focuses on human-robot interaction, semantic navigation, and safety models designed to allow physical proximity rather than industrial light-curtain isolation.

items.title: What Exactly Is a Baker’s Cyst—And Can You Get Rid of It?
items.subtitle: Mechanisms, causes, and treatment options for Baker's cysts in runners.
items.original_title: What Exactly Is a Baker’s Cyst—And Can You Get Rid of It?
items.summary: A Baker's cyst is an overflow of fluid from the knee joint that collects at the back of the knee, typically caused by underlying issues like osteoarthritis or meniscus tears. While they are generally painless and not dangerous, treatments range from conservative approaches like anti-inflammatories and physical therapy to aspiration or surgical removal.
bullets: A Baker's cyst occurs when fluid flows from the knee joint to the backside through a one-way valve system due to excess fluid production.
Common underlying triggers include osteoarthritis, inflammatory arthritis, ACL tears, or meniscus tears.
Diagnosis is typically confirmed via MRI and ultrasound, and new lumps should be evaluated to rule out dangerous blood clots.
Running does not need to be modified unless the cyst causes pain or alters gait mechanics, and may offer protective elements for arthritic knees.
Aspiration can drain the fluid, but cysts frequently recur unless the underlying joint issue is addressed.
Addressing root causes like core and glute weakness, meniscus damage, or joint inflammation can help shrink the cyst.

items.title: AI can’t outrun a humanoid’s hardware
items.subtitle: Humanoid hardware constraints limit AI execution in physical joints.
items.original_title: AI can’t outrun a humanoid’s hardware
items.summary: While AI excels at perception and decision-making, humanoid robots face strict physical and electrical hardware constraints at every joint. Moving to 48V architectures reduces wiring weight and resistive losses, but introduces voltage spike challenges during motor deceleration. Integrating sensing, control, power, and safety at the joint level is critical to translating software intent into safe physical action.
bullets: Humanoids require 30+ degrees of freedom with onboard motors, power, and control systems, unlike stationary industrial arms with external cabinets.
Transitioning from 12V to 48V power architecture reduces required current by a factor of four and resistive wiring losses by a factor of 16.
Rapid motor deceleration in 48V systems acts as a generator, producing transient voltages that control electronics must withstand.
Closed-loop control systems use continuous position, current, and torque feedback to translate high-level AI instructions into precise physical movement.
Functional safety, diagnostics, and fault detection must be integrated into joints from inception to protect humans working alongside collaborative robots.

items.title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
items.subtitle: Connecting GPT-5.6 Sol to lab software automates routine quantum chip calibration.
items.original_title: How GPT-5.6 Sol helps run quantum computing experiments
items.summary: MIT researchers used GPT-5.6 Sol connected via Codex to lab software to automate routine measurements and calibrations on superconducting qubits. The agent operates hardware, analyzes incoming data, and adjusts parameters autonomously for standard workflows, saving hours of manual monitoring. However, the agent struggles with weak or noisy signals, requiring human intervention for ambiguous physical results.
bullets: Superconducting qubits are cooled near absolute zero and controlled entirely through software via microwave signals.
GPT-5.6 Sol was given measurement-specific skills to run an uncalibrated six-qubit chip workflow.
The agent successfully chose measurement parameters, operated hardware, evaluated data, and determined qubit transition frequencies and coherence times when signals were clear.
Weak or noisy signals posed challenges, requiring human researcher guidance to find suitable parameters.
Automating routine characterization allows researchers to run overnight tests and focus on experiment design, theory, and data analysis.

items.title: Why Vision AI is the Safety Backbone of the Automated Job Site
items.subtitle: How site-wide vision AI coordinates safety between autonomous machines and human workers.
items.original_title: Why vision AI is the safety backbone of the automated job site
items.summary: As autonomous construction machinery scales, individual robot sensors remain limited to local fields of view. A centralized vision AI perception layer integrates feeds from drones, fixed cameras, and mobile patrol units like viBOT to build a real-time common operational picture of dynamic job sites.
bullets: Construction automation risk concentrates in transition zones where heavy autonomous machines and human workers share unstructured spaces.
OSHA Fatal Four hazards account for up to 59% of US construction deaths, with struck-by incidents involving moving equipment killing over 100 workers annually.
While individual robots possess local perception like lidar and radar, they lack a comprehensive site-wide understanding of human movement.
Vision AI acts as a site-wide perception layer by analyzing live feeds from CCTV, drones, body-worn cameras, and mobile patrol units.
Edge processing allows vision AI systems to detect hazards within seconds without relying on continuous cloud connectivity.
Agentic AI combines computer vision with multi-source data correlation to provide centralized dashboards and low-latency safety interventions.

items.subtitle: Come WhatsApp abilita chiamate via browser per ospiti senza account tramite crittografia end-to-end.
