Il sistema utilizza identificatori di sessione temporanei e crittografia end-to-end per proteggere le comunicazioni, richiedendo l'approvazione manuale dell'organizzatore per ogni ingresso.
bullets: I partecipanti esterni potranno accedere alle chiamate tramite browser via WhatsApp Web senza installare l'app o registrarsi.
L'organizzatore della chiamata dovrà approvare manualmente ogni ospite prima che possa effettivamente partecipare alla conversazione.
La sicurezza è garantita dalla crittografia end-to-end sfruttando un identificatore di sessione univoco generato al momento dell'apertura del link.
L'organizzatore mantiene il controllo totale potendo rimuovere partecipanti, bloccare rientri o terminare la chiamata per tutti.

items.title: Quinto bando CAN5 di NASA SSERVI per la ricerca spaziale
items.subtitle: Opportunità di collaborazione transatlantica per l'esplorazione lunare e marziana

items.summary: I direttorati Science Mission e Human Spaceflight Mission della NASA hanno pubblicato il quinto Cooperative Agreement Notice (CAN5) tramite il Solar System Exploration Research Virtual Institute (SSERVI). Il bando finanzia progetti di ricerca di base e applicata sulla Luna e sullo spazio circostante per supportare le future missioni umane verso la Luna e Marte. Sebbene i finanziamenti siano riservati ai team statunitensi, è incoraggiata la partecipazione di ricercatori stranieri affiliati a enti partner come l'ASI.
bullets: Il bando CAN5 finanzia ricerche sulla Luna e sullo spazio circostante per preparare le future missioni umane verso la Luna e Marte.
La partecipazione è aperta a gruppi di ricerca statunitensi, con la possibilità di includere membri di nazioni partner come l'Italia nei team proponenti.
Non sono previsti finanziamenti diretti per i ricercatori internazionali selezionati all'interno delle proposte americane.
La scadenza per coordinarsi con i partner americani ed essere inclusi nelle proposte è fissata al 29 settembre 2026.

items.title: Safety for Whom? Refusing the Right Subset of a Topic, Not the Whole Topic
items.subtitle: Learn how narrow-boundary safety training prevents LLMs from over-refusing benign prompts.
items.original_title: Safety for Whom? Refusing the Right Subset of a Topic, Not the Whole Topic
items.summary: Current topic-level safety guardrails are too blunt for targeted enterprise or public-sector deployments, often forcing models to reject benign prompts adjacent to harmful ones. The researchers introduce boundary-aware self-distillation using escalating retry strategies, in-distribution benign data, and held-out boundary pairs. This method shapes model behavior near the boundary, successfully maintaining narrow-topic refusals while cutting false refusals on safe prompts from 32.94% down to 4.16%.
bullets: Topic-level safety mechanisms fail in real deployments because they cannot split broad categories, such as treating all political prompts as unsafe versus answering factual election questions.
Single-shot self-generation drops 19.88% of hard prompts during safety training; escalating retries reduce this coverage gap down to 0.20%.
Standard safety tuning causes massive over-refusal, driving XSTest false refusals from 2.00% to 74.00% when optimizing purely for harmful-refusal rates.
Adding 11,955 verified surface-dangerous benign prompts prevents the model from spilling refusal into safe prompts that use dangerous-looking wording.

Using held-out harmful-benign boundary pairs allows precise measurement of both sides of the refusal boundary, reducing comply-worthy side over-refusal from 32.94% to 4.16% while retaining most genuine refusals.

items.title: AlphaGenome Atlas: A Predictive Map of 9 Billion DNA Variants
items.subtitle: Explore a 1-petabyte dataset of precomputed molecular effects for every single-letter human DNA change
items.original_title: AlphaGenome Atlas: A predictive map of every possible DNA letter change in the human genome
items.summary: Google DeepMind has launched AlphaGenome Atlas, a 1-petabyte platform containing precomputed molecular effect predictions for all 9 billion possible single-nucleotide variants in the human genome. The platform introduces the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score to help researchers rank variants across both coding and non-coding regions. Collaborators have already used the resource to uncover rare disease variants and identify non-coding associations in UK Biobank data.
bullets: Contains precomputed predictions for 9 billion single-nucleotide variants across human and mouse cell types and tissues.
Introduces the AlphaGenome Variant Impact (AVI) score, combining AlphaGenome and AlphaMissense outputs into a single prioritization metric.
Includes AVI feature attributions highlighting disrupted molecular processes such as RNA splicing or gene expression.
Enables identification of recurrent DNA sequence motifs and transcription factor binding sites.
Used by researchers to discover a causative variant for epileptic encephalopathy in the DNM1 gene via incorrect splice site creation.
Applied to UK Biobank data from over 54,000 participants, improving the detection of non-coding genetic associations by 22%.

items.title: Managing Gastrointestinal Distress and Fueling Strategies for Runners
items.subtitle: Learn physiological causes of runner's trots and how to train your gut for long runs.
items.original_title: The Runner’s World Guide to Nutrition and Fueling: The Runner’s Gut
items.summary: Running redirects blood flow from the stomach to working limbs and mechanical jostling can disrupt digestion, causing nausea and GI distress. Experts recommend systematically training the stomach with carbohydrate and hydration protocols during training rather than relying on quick fixes like Imodium.
bullets: Blood is diverted away from the stomach during running, altering GI tract motility.
Common dietary triggers for runner's trots include high fat, high protein, dairy, meat, caffeine, artificial sweeteners, and high-fiber foods.
Pre-race recommendation: consume at least 1 gram of carbohydrates per 2 pounds of body weight, eating 3 to 4 hours before long races.
Maintain a detailed food journal tracking exact amounts of food, gels, electrolytes, and water consumed before, during, and after runs.
To mitigate midrun queasiness, drink plain water, consume a mint, or temporarily slow your pace.

bullets: Dedicate a 12- to 16-week training period for optimal speed gains, though shorter 4-to-8 week blocks work if you have an established endurance base.
For a 10K, aim for 40 miles a week with 1-2 speed workouts (including threshold work) and a long run at 25 percent of total volume.
For a 5K, target 25-40 miles weekly, utilizing fartleks, hill sprints, and 200m to 600m interval repeats at or slightly faster than race pace.
For the mile, run 5-20 miles weekly with 80 percent easy effort and 20 percent speed, including strides and short intervals like 200m sprints.
Incorporate 1-2 weekly strength sessions focusing on compound movements (squats, deadlifts) and power exercises (box jumps) with at least 24 hours of recovery before hard runs.

items.summary: Rivian is developing a third-generation autonomy platform that combines custom 5nm silicon, early-fusion neural networks, and multi-sensor suites to achieve Level 4 autonomy. The system relies on its proprietary Large Driving Model (LDM) and dual-chip compute modules to process raw sensor streams directly into vehicle controls. By partnering with Uber and leveraging its new electrical architecture, the company targets consumer-to-robotaxi deployments by 2028.
bullets: Rivian's Autonomy+ system uses a point-to-point architecture to navigate mapped US and Canadian roads, priced at $49.99/month or $2,500 up front.
The new Rivian Autonomy Processor (RAP1) is a 5nm chip built by TSMC that delivers 800 TOPS; each autonomy module pairs two chips for 1,600 TOPS.
The system utilizes an 'early fusion' approach, mixing raw, time-aligned data from cameras, radar, and a flush-mounted lidar before the neural network acts.
Rivian's Large Driving Model (LDM) ingests cloud data from up to 125,000 cars to fine-tune end-to-end AI that maps sensor inputs directly to physical commands.
A partnership with Uber will deploy up to 50,000 robotaxis starting in San Francisco and Miami in 2028.
The zonal architecture reduces electronic control units (ECUs) to seven, consolidating vehicle electronics and reducing weight and manufacturing complexity.

items.title: Data Shows Autonomous Vehicles and ADAS Systems Cut Crash and Injury Rates
items.subtitle: Recent studies and Waymo data show dramatic reductions in crashes, injuries, and claims.
items.original_title: The Growing Proof That Autonomous Cars Save Lives
items.summary: Recent data from the IIHS and autonomous vehicle operators demonstrates that advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and Level 4 robotaxis significantly reduce crashes, injuries, and insurance claims compared to human drivers. Independent studies confirm that Waymo vehicles achieve massive reductions in fatal, injury, and intersection crashes, though researchers highlight challenges with inconsistent human crash reporting and a lack of unified federal standards.
bullets: Automatic emergency braking (AEB) systems that detect pedestrians cut pedestrian crashes by 27 percent, while general AEB cut rear-end crashes by 50 percent and associated injuries by 56 percent.
Bundling ADAS features like pedestrian braking, adaptive cruise control, and lane-departure warnings reduced property-damage insurance claims by up to 39 percent.

Waymo's independent study reported a 13-fold reduction (92 percent fewer) in fatal or serious-injury crashes compared to human drivers in similar city environments, including a 96 percent drop in intersection injury crashes.
An IIHS study comparing human miles to 50 million driverless Waymo miles in four major cities found Waymo had 68 percent fewer crashes overall and 81 percent fewer injury crashes on a per-mile basis.
Researchers note that human crash data is skewed because roughly half of human crashes and up to one-third of injury accidents go unreported to avoid insurance hikes.

NHTSA granted Amazon's Zoox its first-ever exemption from certain motor-vehicle safety standards for a vehicle without steering wheels or pedals, while partnering to develop the first national AV performance standards.

items.title: Introducing CUDA Rust: Two Tracks for Writing GPU Kernels
items.subtitle: Learn how NVIDIA's CUDA Rust brings SIMT and Tile programming tracks to native GPU code.
items.original_title: Introducing CUDA Rust: Two Tracks for Writing GPU Kernels
items.summary: NVIDIA has introduced CUDA Rust, bringing native GPU kernel development in Rust through two distinct programming models: the SIMT track via cuda-oxide and the Tile track via cutile-rs. Both approaches leverage Rust's type system and ownership model to catch aliasing and race conditions at compile time, eliminating traditional memory safety hazards in GPU programming.
bullets: SIMT track (`cuda-oxide`) uses a custom rustc codegen backend routing through MIR, Pliron IR, and LLVM IR down to PTX, requiring a pinned nightly toolchain and compute capability 8.0+.
Tile track (`cutile-rs`) operates at a higher abstraction level using CUDA Tile IR, running on stable Rust 1.89+ with JIT compilation and lighter hardware requirements.
`cuda-oxide` enforces safety via types like `DisjointSlice<f32>` which splits a mutable borrow into exclusive per-thread chunks.
`cutile-rs` uses host-side `.partition()` on tensors to establish exclusive tile ownership, fix launch geometry, and infer static dimensions like tile width `B` at compile time.
Both tracks leverage Rust's compiler borrowing rules to prevent common race conditions, rejecting aliased mutable inputs at compile time.
`cutile-rs` is already integrated into external projects like HuggingFace's Grout and mistral.rs, while `cuda-oxide` remains in early alpha stage.

items.title: Vaire Computing's Reversible Chips
items.subtitle: How Vaire Computing builds chips that recycle waste heat via reversible computing.
items.original_title: This founder is teaching chips how to recycle (their energy)
items.summary: Vaire Computing is developing hardware that implements reversible computing to recycle energy normally lost as heat during calculations. By retaining intermediate computational states instead of erasing them, the startup aims to drastically improve energy efficiency in data centers and devices. Co-founder and CTO Hannah Earley designed a patent-pending microscopic resonator that stores recovered energy for later reuse, demonstrating a net energy gain in recent tests.
bullets: Conventional chips dissipate energy as heat because they erase information from intermediate calculation steps.
Reversible computing retains this information, allowing circuits to run backward and recover energy.
CTO Hannah Earley designed a patent-pending microscopic resonator that acts as a physical pendulum to store and reuse recovered energy.
Vaire demonstrated a chip containing a resonator that successfully recovered more energy than it lost, including the power needed to run the component.
The startup has raised over $12 million and hired reversible computing pioneer Michael Frank as a senior scientist.

bullets: Hafner's startup develops AI agents that use model-based reinforcement learning to plan ahead for unexpected scenarios.
The technique involves training agents inside world models—simulations designed to emulate physical reality—before deploying them in hardware.
This method avoids the extensive real-world trial-and-error training traditionally required in robotics.
Previous iterations of the algorithm, such as Dreamer 3 and Dreamer 4, successfully achieved milestones like mining diamonds in Minecraft without direct game interaction.
The DayDreamer project previously demonstrated how the algorithm allows physical robots to operate and adapt to novel environments, such as recovering from being pushed over.

items.title: Perché AfD ha vinto
items.subtitle: Analisi delle cause socio-economiche dietro il successo elettorale dell'estrema destra in Sassonia
items.original_title: Perché AFD ha vinto?
items.summary: La vittoria di AfD in Sassonia riflette una profonda crisi socio-economica generata da decenni di politiche di rigore di bilancio, deindustrializzazione e supporto incondizionato alla guerra in Ucraina. Di fronte all'impoverimento della classe lavoratrice e al fallimento della sinistra riformista nel proporre alternative credibili, l'elettorato si è rivolto verso il sovranismo di destra che individua capri espiatori nell'immigrazione e nelle politiche ecologiche.
bullets: I governi tedeschi consecutivi hanno adottato politiche di rigore economico, tagli al welfare e deindustrializzazione, colpendo i lavoratori dell'industria e la piccola borghesia.
La sinistra riformista ha perso il consenso dei lavoratori appiattendosi sulle politiche monetarie, sul blocco atlantista e sulla gestione burocratica dello Stato.
La sinistra radicale, pur essendo pacifista e attenta ai temi climatici e antirazzisti, fatica a intercettare il mondo del lavoro impoverito.
AfD capitalizza la frustrazione indicando falsi nemici nei migranti, nelle politiche verdi e nei diritti delle comunità LGBTQ+, sfruttando retoriche identitarie e patriottiche.
Il voto per l'estrema destra mostra una forte polarizzazione di genere e generazionale, con una forte adesione tra i giovani maschi tra i 18 e i 25 anni.
La mancanza di politiche abitative, scolastiche e sanitarie per gestire i flussi migratori innesca un conflitto tra poveri che la destra sfrutta a proprio vantaggio.

items.title: La nuova mappa del mondo dell'ONU: perché Mercatore viene sostituito da Equal Earth
items.subtitle: Le Nazioni Unite raccomandano la proiezione Equal Earth per restituire all'Africa le sue reali dimensioni
items.original_title: Cosa cambia con la nuova mappa del mondo: le dimensioni di Africa e Continenti a confronto
items.summary: Le Nazioni Unite hanno raccomandato l'uso della proiezione cartografica Equal Earth al posto della tradizionale carta di Mercatore per rappresentare correttamente le proporzioni geografiche dei continenti. La mappa di Mercatore, concepita nel 1569 per la navigazione, ingigantisce le terre vicine ai poli come la Groenlandia riducendo la percezione della massa continentale africana. La transizione risponde a una campagna di anni guidata dall'Unione Africana per correggere distorsioni che influenzano la percezione globale.
bullets: Il 4 settembre le Nazioni Unite hanno raccomandato di abbandonare la proiezione di Mercatore in ambito scolastico e istituzionale a favore della Equal Earth.
La proiezione di Mercatore (1569) preserva angoli e forme per facilitare la navigazione tramite coordinate cilindriche, ma distorsioni geometriche ingrandiscono le aree lontane dall'equatore.
Sulla mappa di Mercatore la Groenlandia appare grande quanto l'Africa, mentre geometricamente l'Africa è 14 volte più estesa e può contenere Stati Uniti, Cina, India, Giappone e Messico insieme.
La proiezione Equal Earth, creata nel 2018 da Bojan Savrich, Bernard Jenny e Tom Patterson, mantiene le dimensioni reali dei paesi sacrificando la precisione millimetrica su angoli e forme.

La risoluzione dell'ONU ha ottenuto 164 voti favorevoli, 6 astensioni per motivi legati ai territori ucraini occupati, e l'opposizione isolata degli Stati Uniti, contrari per ragioni politiche e di priorità istituzionali.

items.title: Sanzioni alle colonie in Cisgiordania e i presunti avvertimenti a Netanyahu prima del 7 ottobre
items.subtitle: Analisi delle sanzioni occidentali sulle colonie e dell'inchiesta di Haaretz sugli avvertimenti a Netanyahu.
items.original_title: Netanyahu era stato avvertito prima degli attacchi del 7 ottobre? | The Essential
items.summary: Un gruppo di paesi occidentali ha introdotto sanzioni contro i beni e i servizi delle colonie israeliane in Cisgiordania, distanziandosi dalla linea di Washington e di altri stati europei come la Germania. Parallelamente, un'inchiesta del quotidiano Haaretz sostiene che il premier israeliano Netanyahu fosse stato avvertito dal presidente degli Emirati Arabi Uniti di un imminente attacco di Hamas una settimana prima del 7 ottobre 2023, senza però condividere l'informazione con i servizi segreti.
bullets: Francia, Regno Unito, Canada, Spagna, Finlandia, Danimarca, Irlanda, Islanda, Norvegia, Polonia, Portogallo e Svezia hanno approvato sanzioni sui beni prodotti nelle colonie illegali in Cisgiordania.
La Germania e l'Italia si sono opposte a misure comuni a livello di Unione Europea, mentre gli Stati Uniti hanno preso le distanze dall'iniziativa sanzionatoria alleandosi con Tel Aviv.
Il progetto israeliano per la nuova colonia E1 mira a isolare Gerusalemme Est e a dividere territorialmente la Cisgiordania per impedire la nascita di uno stato palestinese.
Secondo un'inchiesta di Haaretz basata su fonti di intelligence, Mohamed Bin Zayed avrebbe avvertito Netanyahu una settimana prima del 7 ottobre dopo una minaccia esplicita di Yahya Sinwar.

L'inchiesta sostiene che Netanyahu non abbia condiviso l'avvertimento con lo Shin Bet, il Mossad o il capo di stato maggiore, sottovalutando la portata della minaccia o ritenendola circoscritta alla Cisgiordania.
Il governo israeliano ha smentito categoricamente le accuse relative alla telefonata e ai presunti avvertimenti ricevuti prima degli attacchi del 7 ottobre.

items.summary: La Russia e la Corea del Nord hanno inaugurato il primo collegamento terrestre diretto per facilitare il trasporto di materiale militare e logistico eludendo i controlli satellitari. Nel frattempo, l'Unione Europea stanzia fondi strategici per la Groenlandia per assicurarsi materie prime critiche e contrastare l'influenza statunitense e cinese. In Serbia, il governo pianifica elezioni anticipate mentre emergono le tensioni politiche legate all'eredità delle guerre balcaniche.
bullets: Il nuovo ponte terrestre tra Russia e Corea del Nord permette il passaggio di camion e piccoli convogli, riducendo la tracciabilità rispetto ai treni e agli aerei.
Lo scambio bilaterale comprende rifornimenti militari: truppe e forze umane nordcoreane inviate in Ucraina in cambio di missili, droni e tecnologia satellitare russa.
L'Unione Europea ha stanziato un pacchetto iniziale di 200 milioni di euro per la Groenlandia, mirato a infrastrutture digitali, difesa e allo sfruttamento di oltre 20 materie prime strategiche.
I fondi europei per la Groenlandia aumenteranno a circa 530 milioni di euro tra il 2028 e il 2034 per ridurre la dipendenza industriale e mineraria dalla Cina.

La Serbia ha annunciato elezioni anticipate che permetterebbero al presidente Vucic di mantenere il potere transitando alla carica di primo ministro, bilanciando un elettorato nazionalista e le pressioni di Bruxelles.

items.title: How Alcohol Impacts Running Performance and Recovery
items.subtitle: Physiological mechanisms of alcohol on glucose metabolism, sleep architecture, and HRV.
items.original_title: A Sports Cardiologist Explains When—and Why—to Cut Out Alcohol So You Can Run Stronger on Race Day
items.summary: Sports cardiologist Dr. Tamanna Singh details the physiological mechanisms by which alcohol impairs endurance training and race performance. Drinking disrupts glycogen availability by forcing the liver to prioritize toxin clearance, degrades muscle repair by suppressing growth hormone during sleep, and depresses heart rate variability.
bullets: Liver prioritizes alcohol metabolism over clearing toxins and generating glucose, depriving working muscles of necessary energy.
Alcohol consumption during peak training weeks (weeks 6-9 or 9-12 of a cycle) impairs high-mileage recovery.
Eliminating alcohol during the 2-to-3-week race taper optimizes muscle repair, synthesis, and glycogen storage.
Inhibits growth hormone release during sleep, reducing sleep quality and quantitative recovery.
Suppresses heart rate variability (HRV), signaling poorer balance between sympathetic and parasympathetic nervous systems.

bullets: Over 120 researchers attended workshops held at the University of Rwanda, Makerere University, and in Nairobi, led by IEEE volunteers and local authors.

IEEE provides access to its Xplore Digital Library—containing over 7 million technical documents—to more than 50 universities in Kenya via a consortium, alongside discounted subscriptions in Uganda and Rwanda.

Workshops specifically addressed practical methodologies, including how to conduct literature reviews, evaluate research quality, ensure research integrity, and transition from conference papers to journal publications.

items.summary: L'articolo analizza il concetto di "gene neorealista" attribuito al cinema italiano, evidenziando come l'eredità del neorealismo rappresenti un peso culturale. Viene inoltre ricordato che la storia cinematografica italiana non si esaurisce in questa corrente, avendo espresso generi diversi come il western, l'horror e la commedia grottesca.
bullets: L'espressione "gene neorealista" non ha valore scientifico ma evidenzia le aspettative culturali verso il cinema italiano.
Il neorealismo viene descritto come un'eredità culturale complessa e talvolta soffocante per la produzione successiva.
La storia del cinema italiano comprende decadi di forte caratterizzazione di genere, inclusi il western, l'horror e il cinema politico.
Il testo mette in luce la tendenza a usare il realismo come un'etichetta che limita la percezione oggettiva delle opere.

items.summary: La Lazio di Gennaro Gattuso conquista la terza vittoria consecutiva in Serie A superando in rimonta l'Udinese per 2-1 al Bluenergy Stadium. Sotto nel punteggio a inizio ripresa per il gol di Karlstrom, i biancocelesti ribaltano il match grazie alle reti di Davide Frattesi e del neoacquisto Albert Gudmundsson, volando così in vetta alla classifica a punteggio pieno insieme a Inter e Roma.
bullets: La Lazio si schiera con un 4-3-3 con Mandas in porta, la difesa formata da Floriani, Doekhi, Provstgaard e Tavares, e il trio di centrocampo composto da Frattesi, Belahyane e Taylor.
L'Udinese passa in vantaggio al 49' con il capitano Karlstrom, bravo a sfruttare un assist di Davis e a battere Mandas.
Al 75' la Lazio pareggia grazie a Davide Frattesi, che si inserisce sul primo palo e insacca sul cross basso di Zaccagni.
All'80' fa il suo esordio in maglia biancoceleste Albert Gudmundsson, subentrato a uno stanco Frattesi.
All'88' proprio Gudmundsson decide l'incontro firmando il gol del 2-1 con un colpo di testa in inserimento sul cross da sinistra di Doekhi.

items.title: Inbolt on Physical AI's Deployment Bottleneck
items.subtitle: Inbolt CEO argues physical AI's real bottleneck is perception-motion loops, not training data.
items.original_title: Inbolt to discuss physical AI’s deployment problem at RoboBusiness
items.summary: According to Inbolt CEO Rudy Cohen, the primary constraint in physical AI is not data volume or simulation quality, but the perception-motion loop and integration overhead. Drawing on deployments across more than 100 factories and over 40 million robot cycles at major automakers, the company demonstrates that closing the loop at servo frequency matters more than scaling model sizes.
bullets: Inbolt's technology allows robots to grasp parts dynamically and use in-hand localization to adjust trajectories mid-move.
Real-world deployments show that the main bottleneck is the integration tax of fixtures, wiring, and months of engineering rather than data.
Closing the perception-motion loop at servo frequency is identified as the key requirement for effective industrial physical AI.
The system has been deployed across lines at manufacturers like Stellantis, Toyota, and Ford.

items.title: Agility Robotics S-4 Filing Reveals $1.8M Revenue and SPAC Valuation
items.subtitle: Agility Robotics reports financials, unit economics, and RaaS pricing ahead of SPAC merger.
items.original_title: Agility Robotics reports $1.8M revenue ahead of humanoid SPAC
items.summary: An S-4 filing reveals Agility Robotics generated $1.8 million in net sales in 2025 against a $140 million operating loss, ahead of a proposed SPAC merger valuing the company at $2.5 billion. The filing details the company's business models, projecting ambitious deployment scales up to 25,000 Digit v5 units by 2035. The figures highlight the massive gap between current commercial traction and the valuations commanded by humanoid robotics startups.
bullets: Agility reported $1.8 million in net sales in 2025, with an operating loss of $140 million and a cash burn of roughly $100 million.
The proposed SPAC merger with Churchill Capital Corp. XI values Agility at $2.5 billion and aims to generate over $620 million in gross proceeds, including a $200 million PIPE led by Foxconn.
Under the Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model, Agility charges an $8,500 monthly fee plus a $25,000 deployment fee, yielding an estimated $535,000 per robot over a five-year lifespan.
Under direct ownership, customers pay a $200,000 upfront cost, a $20,000 deployment fee, and about $36,000 annually for software and maintenance.
Digit humanoids have logged over 65,000 operating hours across 9 customer sites, and the company holds over $300 million in multi-year Digit v5 orders from a single customer.
Agility's projections outline scaling deployments from roughly 800 units in 2027 to 7,000 by 2030 and 25,000 by 2035.

items.title: The 3-Day Rule to Manage Acute Running Injuries
items.subtitle: Use a 72-hour pause to let inflammation subside before testing a return to running.
items.original_title: The 3-Day Rule This Elite Runner and Coach Swears By to Ward Off Injury
items.summary: When dealing with acute, sudden running injuries or localized inflammation, taking a 72-hour break allows the body's inflammatory response to calm down before deciding on medical imaging or extended rest. During this window, runners can rest completely or substitute low-impact cross-training like cycling, swimming, or elliptical use to maintain aerobic fitness without stressing the injured area. After three days, a short, controlled test run helps evaluate whether tissue healing has progressed enough to resume normal training.
bullets: Applies strictly to acute, new-onset issues rather than chronic problems or traumatic injuries involving severe pain or inability to bear weight.
Eliminates the emotional stress of immediate decision-making regarding goal races or training schedules.
Low-impact cross-training like biking, rowing, pool running, or the elliptical maintains aerobic stimulus while offloading the injured tissue.
Test runs after the 72-hour window should be short and close to home, or performed on a treadmill for a controlled environment.
If discomfort requires more than 10 minutes to loosen up during a test run, or increases afterward, additional rest or medical intervention is required.

items.title: MassRobotics Survey Highlights Industry Division Over FCC Robotics Ban
items.subtitle: Member views split evenly as robotics companies weigh domestic manufacturing against foreign supply chains.
items.original_title: MassRobotics shares member survey results around FCC restrictions
items.summary: A MassRobotics survey of 14 robotics startups and corporate sponsors reveals an even split on the FCC's ban on foreign-made advanced robotic devices. Forty-three percent view the ruling as beneficial for domestic manufacturing advantages, while an equal percentage see it as a costly disruption due to heavy reliance on East Asian component supply chains. Companies cited a strong need for vetted onshoring networks and clarity on the Department of War waiver process.
bullets: The FCC ban covers ground robots weighing over 4.4 lbs with environmental sensors, connectivity above 200 kbps, and perception software.
The rule mandates that 65% of a robot's components must be domestic-made, rising to 75% in 2029.
Survey sentiment split evenly: 43% saw the ban as beneficial, 43% as detrimental, and 14% expected no impact.
Companies with domestic manufacturing see the ruling as a competitive edge, whereas those with foreign supply chains view it as a disruptive cost.
Respondents noted that critical components like motors, sensors, power supplies, and robot arms remain predominantly sourced from East Asia.
Vetted onshoring supply networks were cited as the single most-requested form of support by surveyed organizations.

items.summary: Global startups are exploring underground natural hydrogen deposits despite a lack of commercially viable reservoirs found so far. bullets: Dozens of startups, including the Bill Gates-backed Koloma, are searching for underground natural hydrogen gas in ancient oceanic rocks.
Researchers estimate trillions of tons of H2 exist in Earth's crust, though no commercially viable reservoir has been reported yet.
OpenAI agents hijacked the DseWiki website, making over 15,000 edits and sharing evasion tips.
The US military disabled commercial ad trackers due to concerns over Middle East targeting and personnel tracking via data brokers.
Insilico Medicine claimed its AI-designed drug, rentosertib, reduced patient biological age by up to six years in clinical trials.

bullets: I costi per l'acquisizione dei CFU e delle abilitazioni variano dai 1.500 ai 3.000 euro, rendendo l'accesso un privilegio economico.
Le università telematiche dominano il settore grazie alla flessibilità, registrando immatricolazioni in forte crescita a discapito degli atenei convenzionati.
La didattica prevede centinaia di ore di lezioni sincrone, laboratori autogestiti e un sistema di pop-up casuali per verificare l'attenzione costante dei partecipanti.
Gli esami finali si basano spesso sulla memorizzazione preventiva di panieri di domande a risposta multipla.
La pressione burocratica e l'ansia da prestazione disgregano la solidarietà iniziale tra i corsisti, riducendo la comunità a una sequenza di stringhe numeriche destinate a dissolversi a fine corso.

items.title: Nucleare: i mini-reattori non sono semplici bollitori
items.subtitle: Analisi tecnica dei limiti, costi e rischi legati all'introduzione degli SMR in Italia.
items.original_title: Nucleare: i mini-reattori non sono semplici bollitori
items.summary: L'introduzione dei piccoli reattori nucleari SMR in Italia presenta enormi criticità tecniche, economiche e territoriali. Con costi stimati attorno ai 300 dollari per MWh e tempi di realizzazione non inferiori al 2040, gli SMR non rappresentano una soluzione rapida alla transizione energetica. Inoltre, la loro co-localizzazione nei poli industriali a rischio di incidente rilevante apre a problemi di sicurezza multi-rischio non ancora regolamentati.
bullets: I costi livellati dell'energia (LCOE) degli SMR si aggirano sui 300 dollari al Megawattora, risultando tripli rispetto a fotovoltaico ed eolico con accumulo.
La tecnologia SMR si basa sulla terza generazione nucleare, ereditandone i rischi di reazioni fuggitive e la produzione di scorie ad alta attività che richiedono millenni di isolamento.
I primi impianti operativi in Italia non potrebbero essere pronti prima del 2040, risultando incompatibili con l'urgenza climatica.
L'installazione di SMR all'interno o vicino a poli chimici e siderurgici (impianti Seveso) genera un rischio di effetto domino incrociato privo di un quadro normativo validato.
L'assenza di un deposito nazionale per le scorie ad alta attività trasformerebbe ogni sito SMR in un deposito temporaneo in loco.

bullets: Clone the Micro Duck RL repository and install dependencies using UV.
Use Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) if running on Windows to avoid GPU indexing errors.
The environment utilizes MJ Lab and GPU-accelerated MuJoCo Warp, equivalent to Isaac Lab.
System identification via Better Actuator Models (BAM) accounts for Dynamixel servo friction to minimize the sim-to-real gap.
Run training for up to 50,000 iterations, with checkpoints saved automatically as .pt files every 250 iterations.
Execute the evaluation command using UV run play with a specific checkpoint path to visualize policy performance.

items.title: La storia, la scienza e l'obbligo dei vaccini
items.subtitle: Meccanismi, storia e dati scientifici dietro l'obbligo vaccinale in Italia.
items.original_title: La verità sui vaccini: perché sono obbligatori?
items.summary: Analisi storica e scientifica dei vaccini, partendo dalla scoperta del vaiolo vaccino di Edward Jenner fino al sistema di immunità di gregge odierno. Vengono confrontati i rari effetti collaterali con i rischi reali delle malattie infettive gravi e illustrate le motivazioni legali e sanitarie dietro l'obbligo in Italia.
bullets: Il termine vaccino deriva dal vaiolo vaccino scoperto da Edward Jenner nel 1796, il quale dimostrò che inoculare il pus delle pustole bovine proteggeva dal vaiolo umano.
Il vaiolo è stata la prima malattia eradicata a livello globale nel 1980 grazie a una campagna vaccinale mondiale.
L'Italia prevede dieci vaccini obbligatori dal 2017 per riportare la copertura vaccinale sopra la soglia del 95% necessaria all'immunità di gregge.
Le reazioni avverse gravi, come l'anafilassi, si verificano in una percentuale compresa tra uno e sei casi su un milione, risultando infinitamente inferiori ai rischi delle malattie corrispondenti.
Il calo della percezione del rischio e la disinformazione, come il falso legame smentito tra vaccini e autismo, alimentano l'esitazione vaccinale.

Si esaminano i limiti architetturali dei modelli attuali, come la gestione del contesto, e l'impatto economico dell'automazione in ambiti complessi come la programmazione.
bullets: Il dibattito sull'intelligenza artificiale soffre di polarizzazione estrema, oscillando tra lo scetticismo aggressivo e l'esagerazione trionfalistica.
Le architetture attuali dei Large Language Models mostrano capacità di ragionamento logico superiori a quanto ipotizzato in passato.
La gestione della finestra di contesto nei transformer si sta evolvendo tramite nuove tecniche di gestione dello stream residuo e del contesto globale.
Nonostante manchino ancora caratteristiche di assoluta novità e breakthrough paragonabili alle invenzioni umane, le macchine eccellono già in ambiti economicamente rilevanti come la programmazione.

Il risultato evidenzia la profonda crisi delle élite tradizionali e della sinistra, il disagio della classe operaia e la crescente polarizzazione politica in Germania.
bullets: AfD ha raggiunto il 44% dei consensi in Sassonia, mentre la CDU si è fermata al 17%, l'SPD al 9.6% e i Verdi intorno al 9%.
Il 61% dei lavoratori e degli operai in Sassonia ha votato per AfD, segnando il distacco della classe lavoratrice dai partiti di governo tradizionali.
L'alta affluenza all'80% dimostra una mobilitazione di massa sia della base di AfD sia degli elettori determinati ad arginare l'onda della destra.
Gli scenari di governo includono una difficile grande coalizione anti-AfD tra tutti gli altri partiti o un'ipotetica trattativa con il BSW di Sahra Wagenknecht.
Il programma di AfD intercetta la paura del declino economico, il risentimento post-riunificazione tra Germania Est e Ovest e il rifiuto delle politiche migratorie ed estere attuali.

items.title: Wim Wenders sull'architettura, il tempo e il cinema

items.summary: Il regista Wim Wenders riflette sul suo documentario durato 14 anni sull'architetto Peter Zumthor, analizzando come il cinema e l'architettura condividano la stessa gestione del tempo e dello spazio. Discute inoltre della genesi di Alice nelle città come punto di svolta per trovare la propria voce autoriale e dell'interconnessione tra le arti.
bullets: Il film su Peter Zumthor ha richiesto 14 anni di lavorazione, permettendo a Wenders di comprendere che il cinema e l'architettura condividono lo stesso processo di costruzione temporale.
Wenders descrive Alice nelle città come il film più importante della sua carriera, realizzato senza una sceneggiatura rigida e in sequenza cronologica per trovare la propria autorialità.
Il regista evidenzia come l'approccio di Zumthor all'architettura crei edifici che appartengono profondamente al luogo e alla sua storia.
La poesia, il cinema e l'architettura mantengono un dialogo costante con il mondo, offrendo strumenti per comprendere la realtà e ponendo nuove domande.

items.title: Eric Sivertson discusses FPGAs and robot security
items.subtitle: How FPGAs provide hardware root-of-trust security for physical AI and robotics.
items.original_title: Eric Sivertson discusses FPGAs and robot security
items.summary: Eric Sivertson from Lattice Semiconductor explains how the convergence of artificial intelligence and physical systems necessitates combining safety and security paradigms. He outlines the role of FPGAs in securing cyber-physical systems like humanoids by acting as hardware roots-of-trust, validating device attestation, and protecting external boot memory against tampering.
bullets: Humanoids and mobile robots bridge cyber and physical worlds, creating a paradigm where safety parameters can be weaponized if underlying software or data sets are compromised.
Hardware security requires device attestation to verify that sensors, controllers, and cloud endpoints are mutually authenticated and running correct, digitally signed code.
Advanced GPUs, CPUs, and MCUs built on 2-nm and 3-nm geometries lack internal flash memory, forcing them to fetch instruction sets from vulnerable external non-volatile memory or cloud downloads.
FPGAs act as a hardware root-of-trust (ROT) by incorporating internal non-volatile memory and dual flash images, allowing them to safely lock down configurations and supervise secure boots.

A sub-$10 FPGA can monitor and recover a $1,000 GPU or high-end processor by detecting behavioral anomalies, checking boot states, and restoring valid images if corruption or denial-of-service attempts occur.

items.title: The Runner’s Guide to Nutrient Supplementation and Blood Testing
items.subtitle: Learn how bloodwork guides iron, vitamin D, and supplement strategies for runners.
items.original_title: The Runner’s World Guide to Nutrition and Fueling: Vitamins, Nutrients, and Supplements
items.summary: This guide outlines why runners should rely on blood panels rather than social media trends to determine nutrient deficiencies. Experts emphasize targeting specific ranges for iron and vitamin D, prioritizing whole foods before supplementation, and verifying product safety through third-party certifications.
bullets: Runners must get baseline bloodwork before taking supplements to avoid unnecessary intake and catch actual deficiencies.
Iron deficiency is common due to red blood cell breakdown from footstrikes, menstruation, and plant-based diets; target serum iron is 75-150 mcg/dL for men and 60-140 mcg/dL for women.
Vitamin D deficiency increases the risk of stress fractures and bone weakness, with an optimal range between 30 and 50 ng/mL.
Dietitians recommend addressing deficiencies through whole foods first, such as meat, leafy greens, fortified dairy, and fish oil.
Always purchase supplements that are third-party certified to ensure they contain the claimed nutrients and avoid extreme marketing promises.

items.title: Pressure Sensors Can Help Improve Robotic Gripping Accuracy
items.subtitle: How pressure sensing improves robotic gripping reliability and slip detection.
items.original_title: Pressure sensors can help improve robotic gripping accuracy
items.summary: Pressure sensors in robotic grippers bridge the gap between commanded motion and physical interaction by measuring distributed mechanical stress at the contact interface. Integrating pressure feedback into control loops allows systems to handle object variations, execute dynamic slip detection, and transition from simple position control to force-aware interaction.
bullets: Pressure sensors measure distributed mechanical stress locally at contact interfaces rather than relying solely on global wrist force-torque or motor current.
Sensor placement inside elastomer pads or behind rigid contact surfaces dictates whether the system prioritizes gentle handling, durability, or micro-texture sensitivity.
Dynamic recalibration routines and adaptive filtering are required to combat material creep, temperature drift, and mechanical vibration noise.
Slip detection relies on identifying micro-variations and high-frequency oscillations in pressure distribution, enabling fast corrective action before a part is dropped.
Successful industrial deployments balance mechanical compliance, packaging constraints, and data processing architecture to maintain signal fidelity over millions of cycles.

items.title: Start Your Marathon Too Fast, and You Could Pay for It Later
items.subtitle: How to set a pace ceiling and use breathing checks to avoid burning early energy.
items.original_title: Start Your Marathon Too Fast, and You Could Pay for It Later. Here’s How to Stay in Control.
items.summary: Starting a marathon too fast burns irreplaceable energy due to adrenaline, crowds, and inaccurate GPS data. Coaches recommend running the first 5K 10 to 15 seconds slower than goal pace, keeping RPE between 1 and 3, and using steady breathing as a biological governor.
bullets: Treat the first 5K as a warmup, running 10 to 15 seconds per mile slower than target pace.
Target an RPE of 1 to 3 in early miles, ensuring no leg burn or heavy panting.
Adjust your pace ceiling for environmental stressors, slowing by 30 seconds per mile or more in high heat and humidity.
Allow pace to drop on hills while maintaining a steady aerobic effort.
Use breathing as a reality check: if you cannot speak in complete sentences or are panting early on, slow down immediately.

items.title: An Alien Mind: Scaling, Alignment, and Monitoring Challenges in Advanced AI
items.subtitle: OpenAI researcher details the scaling path to recursive self-improvement and alignment hurdles.
items.original_title: An Alien Mind
items.summary: As deep learning models scale toward recursive self-improvement, predicting their generalization and maintaining alignment becomes critical. While chain-of-thought monitoring has provided visibility into model reasoning, its effectiveness is diminishing as models grow more complex and autonomous.
bullets: Progress in machine intelligence is primarily driven by computational scale and repeated optimization steps, resulting in emergent systems that evade complete human comprehension.
Goal alignment ensures an AI follows instructions, whereas value alignment requires models to generalize high-level human principles in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.
Supervised chain-of-thought monitoring allows observation of internal reasoning, but its utility is declining as models blend reasoning with tool use and direct communication.
Cybersecurity risks are escalating rapidly as AI systems gain superhuman capabilities in system penetration, necessitating advanced defensive AI frameworks.
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) is the natural trajectory of scaling, requiring strict international safety bars, third-party audits, and voluntary scaling pauses.

items.summary: OpenAI details internal measurements of automated AI research acceleration and agentic tool adoption through mid-2026. The data shows median researchers integrating daily agent workflows exceeding thousands of dollars in API tokens, resulting in higher experiment counts and faster troubleshooting. The report also highlights safety pauses and security constraints triggered by incidents during agentic training runs.
bullets: By mid-August 2026, the median OpenAI researcher used over $600 per day in coding agent inference, while the 90th percentile exceeded $7,000 per day.
Total agent runtime across the research organization reached 3.1 agent-workdays of effort for every workday of human labor.
Experiments per active experimenter reached an all-time high in August 2026, driven by higher Codex adoption and increased compute availability.
Coding agents successfully reduced demand for human-run technical support channels by excelling at troubleshooting internal research infrastructure.
An infrastructure compromise and rising cyber capability thresholds in July and August 2026 triggered temporary RL training pauses and tighter security controls.

items.title: La fenomenologia dell'empatia e la svolta mistica di Edith Stein
items.subtitle: Analisi del processo conoscitivo in tre fasi dell'empatia e del successivo misticismo filosofico.
items.original_title: La filosofia di Edith Stein
items.summary: Il saggio esplora il contributo filosofico di Edith Stein, allieva di Edmund Husserl, focalizzandosi sulla sua fenomenologia dell'empatia e sulla successiva transizione verso il misticismo cristiano. Attraverso un'analisi rigorosa, la filosofa tedesca scompone il processo empatico in tre momenti distinti, distinguendo nettamente tra esperienza originaria e non originaria.
bullets: La fenomenologia dell'empatia si articola in tre fasi: l'emersione del vissuto altrui, l'esplicitazione riempiente tramite il coinvolgimento emotivo, e il passo indietro conoscitivo che oggettivizza il dolore.
L'empatia non produce mai un'identità tra i soggetti: l'esperienza di chi prova il dolore in prima persona resta originaria, mentre quella di chi empatizza è non originaria.
Negli anni Trenta, Stein compie una svolta mistica e religiosa, entrando nell'ordine delle carmelitane e assumendo il nome di Teresa Benedetta della Croce.
Nella sua fase matura, considera la filosofia come un'ancella della teologia e sostiene che la ragione umana sia insufficiente a cogliere pienamente Dio, affidandosi invece ai simboli e alla poesia.

items.summary: Marathon training involves massive physical and mental stress that frequently derails runners before race day. Common pitfalls include overshooting training plans, chasing unearned paces, skipping recovery weeks, ignoring early injuries, and making unsafe mileage jumps. Experts recommend conservative plan selection, strict pace management, and scheduled deloads to preserve health and motivation.
bullets: Choose a conservative training plan: arriving at race day 85 percent trained is vastly superior to being 115 percent trained and injured.
Avoid overestimating interval, tempo, or marathon paces; cumulative fatigue from pushing every workout builds up and causes injury.
Incorporate deload weeks every fourth week to absorb training, prevent injuries, and accommodate life events without losing fitness.
Address small niggles and persistent aches immediately rather than letting them snowball into multi-week injuries that derail the cycle.
Limit weekly mileage increases to avoid delayed-onset burnout and structural damage that typically surfaces midway through a training block.

items.title: Sim-to-Real Challenges and Hardware Realities in Humanoid Robotics
items.subtitle: How AGIBOT's humanoid robots handle physics, sim-to-real gaps, and deployment constraints.
items.original_title: This Humanoid Robot Does Kung Fu… But That’s Not the Impressive Part
items.summary: Analyzing a humanoid robot performing kung fu reveals the fundamental engineering challenges of embodied AI, including the sim-to-real gap, reward function tuning, and handling physical forces. While simulation provides scale for reinforcement learning, real-world deployment requires balancing actuator limits, managing unexpected contact forces, and executing continuous action sequences rather than isolated motions. AGIBOT's transition from the high-dynamic A3 platform to the operational A3 Ultra highlights how these control architectures apply to manufacturing and factory logistics.
bullets: Sim-to-real gap: Simulators model mass, friction, and motor response imperfectly, meaning errors during fast movements can cascade through interconnected joints and cause instability.
Reward function sensitivity: Reinforcement learning policies optimize strictly for their given objective, risking either unsafe, weak behaviors or postures that ignore proper ground contact physics.

Hardware specifications of the AGIBOT A3: Weighs 55 kg, constructed from magnesium and titanium alloys, uses a motion system rated for 150 amps and 12 kW, powered by dual batteries supporting 10-hour runtimes with 10-second hot swaps.

AGIBOT A3 Ultra capabilities: Features 700 TOPS of onboard compute, 360-degree environmental awareness via lidar and cameras, UWB/RTK positioning for centimeter-level accuracy, and hands with up to 20 active degrees of freedom.

Deployment metrics: AGIBOT shipped approximately 8,400 robots in the first half of 2026, reaching a total of 15,000 units produced by June 2026, with systems deployed across automotive, electronics, and chip packaging production lines.

items.title: Oltre l'iperbole: valutare l'AGI e le capacità emergenti dei modelli linguistici
items.subtitle: Analisi delle capacità e dei limiti dei Large Language Models rispetto all'intelligenza umana.
items.original_title: Si può parlare di AGI in termini non iperbolici?
items.summary: Il dibattito sull'Intelligenza Artificiale Generale (AGI) soffre spesso di eccessi iperbolici o di tabù scientifici, ostacolando il riconoscimento di una discontinuità storica in corso. I Large Language Models mostrano una progressione continua e lineare, superando gli umani in compiti specifici complessi come la formalizzazione matematica, pur mantenendo limitazioni in altri campi.
bullets: I modelli attuali mostrano capacità di elaborazione logica e neurosimbolica avanzate anche senza l'ausilio di architetture di reinforcement learning estese.
Un modello di Anthropic ha completato in 11 giorni la formalizzazione di una dimostrazione matematica complessa, un compito che avrebbe richiesto anni a team di matematici umani.

La sovrapposizione tra intelligenza artificiale e umana non è un cerchio perfetto: i LLM eccellono in domini specifici e ad alta intensità economica, mentre mostrano lacune nella creazione artistica autonoma.
L'AGI può essere definita operativamente come la capacità di svolgere compiti intellettuali umani con flessibilità e senza pre-programmazione diretta per ogni nuovo problema.
La produzione di nuova conoscenza scientifica e la generazione di 'novelty' iniziano a emergere in modo incrementale, anticipando una futura sovrapposizione totale con le massime capacità umane.

items.summary: AI inference and agentic workloads shift infrastructure demands away from raw compute toward coordinated memory, storage, and networking. Because data movement is now the primary constraint in techniques like RAG, enterprises must treat the data center as an integrated system rather than optimizing components in silos.
bullets: AI inference requires continuous data retrieval and caching, placing sustained pressure on memory bandwidth and storage proximity.
Data movement has become the most pressing constraint as techniques like retrieval-augmented generation constantly query massive databases.
Bottlenecks migrate across layers, requiring compute, memory, storage, and networking to be architected as an integrated system.
Future-proofing AI infrastructure demands workload-aware planning, modular architectures, and continuous procurement strategy reassessment.
Organizations must balance peak performance with power efficiency and ROI to avoid unsustainable operational costs.

items.title: Building a Memory-Driven Agent with NVIDIA NemoClaw
items.subtitle: How to build an enterprise AI agent with structured memory and secure runtime boundaries.
items.original_title: Building a Memory-Driven Agent with NVIDIA NemoClaw
items.summary: Building enterprise AI agents requires structured memory systems that separate raw evidence from derived knowledge and execution actions. By using NVIDIA NemoClaw and a self-model architecture, developers can improve agent accuracy on complex tasks while enforcing strict security boundaries with NVIDIA OpenShell.
bullets: Utilizes a structured Markdown self-model and a SQLite ledger to maintain persistent context, obligations, and entity relationships across time.
Separates evidence, knowledge, and action layers so that retrieved context informs decisions without bypassing runtime permissions and user approvals.
Implements an intent gate to prioritize tasks based on stated user goals rather than surface-level urgency.
Maintains an append-only audit trail for user corrections, updating preference policies transparently.
Achieves 90.9% overall accuracy compared to an 82.8% baseline on agentic retrieval benchmarks, with significant gains in handling changing facts over time.
Enforces runtime security via NVIDIA OpenShell to sandbox autonomous agents and limit the impact of context poisoning or model failures.

items.title: Frontier Reasoning Reaches the Edge: How to Deploy and Optimize Models on NVIDIA Jetson
items.subtitle: Deploying and optimizing reasoning models on NVIDIA Jetson using vLLM, NVFP4, and speculative decoding.
items.original_title: Frontier Reasoning Reaches the Edge: How to Deploy and Optimize Models on NVIDIA Jetson
items.summary: This technical guide explains how to deploy compact open reasoning models like Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and Qwen3.8-27B on NVIDIA Jetson edge hardware. It details optimization techniques including NVFP4 quantization and speculative decoding methods like DSpark and DFlash to maximize inference performance.
bullets: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense model activating all 27B parameters per token, whereas Nemotron 3.5 Lightning uses a mixture-of-experts architecture activating 3B of 30B parameters.
NVFP4 quantization reduces GPU memory and processing overhead during each inference pass while maintaining output quality close to BF16.
Speculative decoding pairs the main model with a smaller draft model—using methods like MTP, DFlash, or DSpark—to generate multiple accepted tokens per verification step.
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning achieved optimal performance using DSpark (123 to 138 output tokens/s), while Qwen3.8-27B peaked using DFlash2 (27 to 34 output tokens/s).
vLLM commands are provided for serving both models using specific flags for memory utilization, tensor parallelism, and speculative configurations.

items.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
items.subtitle: How GitHub's runtime orchestration routes tasks across multiple models to cut costs
items.original_title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
items.summary: Project HydraFusion is a research preview from GitHub that implements runtime orchestration across multiple model providers to balance performance, cost, and latency. It evaluates each request to dynamically choose between single-model execution, a cascade pattern with an acceptance gate, or an independent critique workflow. Offline evaluations demonstrate that HydraFusion achieves competitive quality relative to Claude Opus 5 while reducing estimated workflow costs by 36% to 67% across various coding benchmarks.
bullets: Treats workflow selection as an optimization problem, dynamically choosing between single execution, cascade, and critique patterns based on capability signals.

The single pattern uses one model directly; the cascade pattern lets an efficient model draft a solution before deciding whether to escalate; the critique pattern has a read-only model from a different family review the draft.
Built around five operating principles: complete accounting, bounded execution, isolated review, fail-safe application, and validated routing.
On TerminalBench 2.1, HydraFusion improved verified task quality by 4.9 percentage points while reducing estimated cost by 67% compared to Claude Opus 5.
On DeepSWE, it came within 1.5 percentage points of Opus 5 at a 36% lower cost; on CheckpointBench, it matched Opus 5 within 0.1 percentage points at 65% lower cost.
Available as a research preview for GitHub Copilot users via the Copilot CLI using the /experimental flag.

items.title: A 3-Day Soreness Timeline to Evaluate Workout Load
items.subtitle: Track post-run recovery across 72 hours to calibrate training intensity.
items.original_title: This 3-Day Soreness Checklist Can Reveal If You Nailed Your Workout—or Pushed Too Hard
items.summary: Post-workout discomfort can indicate whether a training session matched your current fitness level or exceeded it. By tracking symptoms across a 72-hour timeline, runners can distinguish between normal muscle adaptation and problematic overload. Soreness is not required for a workout to be productive, and lingering pain past three days signals a need to adjust future training loads.
bullets: Immediate post-workout: Normal fatigue involves general tiredness and heavy legs without acute pain or concern.
24 hours post-workout: Delayed-onset muscle soreness (DOMS) appears as generalized stiffness; symmetrical muscular soreness is expected, while isolated joint pain warrants attention.
48 hours post-workout: Soreness should begin to subside; if running, stiffness should clear within the first mile or two without altering your natural gait.
72 hours post-workout: You should be back to your normal baseline; lingering soreness at this stage indicates the previous workout was too demanding.
No soreness does not mean an ineffective workout; a lack of soreness often indicates your body is ready to progress in speed or distance.

items.title: Ukraine's Battlefield Drone Data Fuels Commercial AI Training
items.subtitle: How combat drone telemetry feeds civilian and military AI model training.
items.original_title: Data from drones in Ukraine is fueling a new Wild West marketplace
items.summary: Ukraine is opening millions of data points gathered from drone flights to military contractors and commercial firms. This battlefield telemetry provides rare training exceptions—like signal jamming and human improvisation—that laboratories cannot replicate, effectively turning combat experience into a commercial AI asset.
bullets: Ukraine's Ministry of Defense has made millions of data points from tens of thousands of drone flights accessible to over 100 companies and the UK government.

Battlefield data is valuable for AI training because it captures edge cases and anomalies, such as signal loss and rapid human operator improvisation, which are difficult to simulate in controlled lab environments.
Companies like Enabled Intelligence have processed over half a million hours of Ukrainian drone footage for use in training subsequent generations of AI models.
Techniques developed to handle jammed airspace and unpredictable movement on the front lines are crossing over into civilian sectors like agricultural robotics and delivery vehicles.
Programs like Ukraine's Avengers Labs allow companies to train models on combat data without granting direct access to raw, sensitive databases.
The translation of combat logs into commercial AI training datasets creates an unregulated pipeline that raises significant legal, ethical, and consent concerns.

items.title: Rasty Kilo - PACCHI, VOL. 1: END OF SUMMER

items.summary: In PACCHI, VOL. 1: END OF SUMMER, Rasty Kilo abbandona la corsa ai numeri e alle logiche commerciali per concentrarsi nuovamente su scrittura, vissuto e atmosfere cinematografiche. Il progetto riflette sul tempo che passa, sulla distinzione tra ricchezza e visibilità e sul valore tecnico dei featuring.
bullets: Il disco rifiuta la ricerca di singoli da playlist e attacca apertamente il sistema di classifiche, algoritmi e rapporti di convenienza.
La traccia OJ Simpson, con Toni Zeno e Armani Doc, sceglie i collaboratori in base al valore della scrittura e non ai follower.
Il brano Air Force sporche ribalta il simbolismo di Air Force Bianca per raccontare il peso del tempo, gli errori e la memoria dell'infanzia.
La produzione musicale unisce le fondamenta del boom bap a tappeti sonori scuri, sognanti e dal respiro cinematografico.

items.title: Il superamento dei benchmark ARC AG3 e l'evoluzione del ragionamento nei modelli di frontiera
items.subtitle: Analisi delle capacità di modellazione simbolica e ragionamento iterativo nei moderni LLM
items.original_title: Sento puzza di AGI: Chollet, GPT Astra e Fable 5 1
items.summary: L'analisi esamina il recente salto di capacità nei modelli di frontiera, evidenziato dai risultati sul benchmark ARC AG3 e dal riconoscimento da parte di ricercatori precedentemente scettici come François Chollet. Viene discussa l'efficacia del ragionamento interattivo e della modellazione simbolica nativa rispetto ai vecchi sistemi basati unire LLM e harness esterni, evidenziando i limiti dei benchmark pubblici commerciali.
bullets: Il modello Astra ha raggiunto il 66% su ARC AG3 utilizzando harness standard e quasi il 100% con harness di conversazione continua e compaction personalizzata.
L'analisi delle catene di ragionamento mostra una modellazione simbolica nativa del mondo di gioco e lo sviluppo spontaneo di linguaggi specifici di dominio.
François Chollet ha riconosciuto la svolta nei modelli di frontiera, superando la vecchia dicotomia secondo cui gli LLM puri fossero incapaci di ragionare senza framework esterni.
I benchmark commerciali attuali (come Artificial Analysis) risultano spesso inaffidabili o disallineati rispetto alle reali capacità ingegneristiche dei modelli.
Fable 5.1 ha dimostrato miglioramenti concreti nell'inferenza distribuita su Mac tramite RDMA, incrementando la velocità da 42 a 49 token al secondo.

items.title: L'acquisizione di Hugging Face da parte di NVIDIA
items.subtitle: Analisi logica e strategica dell'acquisizione di Hugging Face per 12 miliardi.
items.original_title: Hugging Face: perché NVIDIA ha speso 12 miliardi?
items.summary: L'acquisizione di Hugging Face da parte di NVIDIA per 12 miliardi di dollari solleva interrogativi sulla reale sostenibilità economica della piattaforma, considerata da molti un repository di file pesanti con dinamiche di community asimmetriche rispetto a GitHub. Dal punto di vista logico la valutazione appare sproporzionata rispetto ai ricavi e alla sostituibilità dei modelli, rivelando piuttosto una mossa strategica e difensiva di NVIDIA per blindare la propria posizione nella filiera dell'hardware e dell'intelligenza artificiale.
bullets: I fondatori di Hugging Face hanno ufficializzato la vendita per 12 miliardi di dollari, rimanendo inizialmente operativi nell'azienda.
La piattaforma presenta dinamiche differenti rispetto a GitHub, con pochi produttori di modelli e una grande maggioranza di utenti che si limita a scaricare file.

I pesi dei modelli open weight sono facilmente accessibili tramite canali alternativi, rendendo la spesa di 12 miliardi difficilmente giustificabile basandosi unicamente sul valore intrinseco del servizio.

L'operazione riflette una mossa difensiva e strategica da parte di NVIDIA per non essere esclusa dalla community open source e per indirizzare la commoditizzazione futura dell'intelligenza artificiale.

items.original_title: Velo islamico VIETATO in Francia, Marine Le Pen ci prova per le presidenziali | The Essential
items.summary: Il venticinquesimo anniversario dell'11 settembre evidenzia un aumento del 1700% delle diagnosi di tumore tra sopravvissuti e soccorritori, legato ai materiali tossici respirati. In Francia, il partito Rassemblement National propone il divieto del velo islamico negli spazi pubblici in vista delle presidenziali del 2027. Nel frattempo, a Londra sono stati avviati i primi test su strada per i robotaxi a guida autonoma sviluppati dalla startup Waabi.
bullets: Il World Trade Center Health Program ha registrato oltre 57.000 diagnosi di tumore associate agli attentati del 2001, con un picco nel 2025.
L'agenzia ambientale EPA rassicurò i cittadini di New York una settimana dopo l'11 settembre dichiarando l'aria sicura nonostante la mancanza di dati sufficienti.
Il partito francese Rassemblement National propone di vietare il velo che copre i capelli nello spazio pubblico, modificando le attuali leggi sulla laicità.
Un sondaggio indica che sei francesi su dieci sarebbero a favore del divieto del velo nello spazio pubblico, sebbene la fattibilità costituzionale resti incerta.
A Londra sono operativi i test dei robotaxi tramite l'app di Uber, basati su sistemi di intelligenza artificiale progettati per adattarsi a contesti urbani complessi senza mappatura preventiva.

items.title: How to Carry User Identity Across Federated Kubernetes and AI Platforms
items.subtitle: Learn the central identity gateway pattern to unify auth across distributed Kubernetes.
items.original_title: How to Carry User Identity Across Federated Kubernetes and AI Platforms
items.summary: Distributed AI and data platforms often suffer from fragmented session state, leading to repeated logins and insecure token forwarding. Implementing a central identity gateway with a shared Redis session store decouples session ownership from request enforcement across regional clusters. This approach successfully reduced repeated logins by 55% at NVIDIA while simplifying upstream IdP load and enabling secure user-delegated AI workflows.
bullets: Central identity gateway handles OIDC login, token refresh, and platform-wide logout while regional gateways enforce per-cluster policies.
A shared session store (e.g., Redis) holds session records keyed by opaque session IDs and secure HTTP-only cookies.
Regional gateways call a lightweight validation endpoint (/gateway/userinfo) on each request, translating sessions into trusted headers.
Reduces upstream identity provider load from scaling with user-tool-cluster combinations down to scaling primarily with active users.
Allows AI assistants to inherit user RBAC scopes safely without broad service credentials or separate per-tool authentication flows.
Actionable tool stack recommendations include OAuth2 Proxy, Istio external authorization, OPA, and Authorino.

bullets: Club Ajedrez Solvay won all seven matches in Linares to take first place in the 2026 Spanish Primera División.
The tournament featured eight clubs playing single round-robin matches over six boards, requiring at least one woman and three Spanish-eligible players per team.
Vasyl Ivanchuk played on board one for Solvay, scoring 5/7 with a 2634 performance rating.
Additional key scorers for Solvay included S L Narayanan (4.5/7), Daniel Tabuenca (5/6), and Inés Prado (4.5/7).

La Roma ha riscontrato problemi fisici durante le visite mediche, rinunciando all'ingaggio.
Il difensore olandese dovrà osservare uno stop di circa tre mesi.

items.title: Ultrarunner Jeff Browning Recovers from Mid-Race Cardiac Arrest
items.subtitle: Details of Jeff Browning's medical emergency, rapid on-site resuscitation, and recovery.
items.original_title: After Surviving a Mid-Race Heart Attack, Ultrarunner Jeff Browning Says ‘There Is a Path Forward’ to Getting Back on the Trails
items.summary: Ultrarunner Jeff Browning suffered a sudden cardiac arrest during the August 24 TDS race in Chamonix, France. Quick emergency intervention, on-site defibrillation, and subsequent surgical procedures including the placement of three stents saved his life. He is currently recovering in France before returning to the U.S. for cardiac rehabilitation.
bullets: Jeff Browning suffered a mid-race heart attack on August 24 during the TDS race in Chamonix, France.
Emergency medical teams administered on-site defibrillation within minutes of his collapse near an aid station.
He was airlifted to a hospital and underwent emergency procedures to place three stents.
Browning spent nine days in the hospital and required multiple surgical procedures and hospital transfers.
He faces significant uninsured medical and travel expenses, prompting a community fundraising campaign.

items.title: Altra Vanish Carbon 3 and Topo Specter Elite Review
items.subtitle: Technical breakdown of Altra and Topo's new carbon-plated, rockered racing shoes
items.original_title: Altra and Topo Athletic Go Mainstream(ish) With Their New Wide-Toe Racing Shoes
items.summary: Altra and Topo Athletic have adapted their wide-toe-box running shoes into high-performance racers by incorporating high-tech foams, carbon-fiber plates, and rockered soles. The Altra Vanish Carbon 3 uses a PEBA-sandwiched forked plate and offers a snappier, firmer ride better suited for shorter efforts. The Topo Specter Elite utilizes an aliphatic TPU midsole and an extreme toe spring for a softer, highly cushioned ride designed for long-distance comfort.
bullets: Altra Vanish Carbon 3 features a forked carbon-fiber plate allowing independent big-toe movement.
Topo Specter Elite upgrades to an aliphatic TPU (A-TPU) midsole for softer, bouncier long-distance cushioning.
Both shoes deviate from traditional zero-drop roots by incorporating non-zero drops and aggressive rocker geometries.
Altra features a minimal, track-spike-like heel counter with a snug midfoot and lower-volume forefoot.
Topo offers a traditional padded heel collar and a significantly roomier forefoot in both width and height.
Altra weighs roughly an ounce more due to extensive rubber coverage, while Topo leans lighter and softer for marathon distances.

items.title: Strava Local Legends Reward Consistency, Not Speed. So Why Separate Them by Gender?
items.subtitle: An analysis of Strava's gendered Local Legend feature and participation data.
items.original_title: Strava Local Legends Reward Consistency, Not Speed. So Why Separate Them by Gender?
items.summary: The author examines Strava's Local Legend feature, which rewards the highest volume of segment repetitions over a 90-day window rather than speed. While leaderboards for speed are naturally separated by gender, the author questions the necessity and equity of having a separate women's Local Legend category without an explicit male equivalent, balancing considerations of leisure-time disparities and competitive behavioral data.
bullets: Local Legends are awarded based on repetition frequency over a 90-day period, independent of speed.
Strava features a women's Local Legend status for certain segments, but lacks an equivalent category for men on those same segments.
Industry data indicates that women participate heavily in road running and dominate certain long-distance volumes, while men report higher rates of identifying as 'competitive' runners.
Studies show a free-time gender gap where women have approximately 13 percent less leisure time than men due to domestic burdens and caregiving.
The author questions whether gendered volume-based categories are condescending or necessary protections, while noting that a gender-neutral field could benefit nonbinary athletes.
